runtimeInputs.name: fieldMetadata
runtimeInputs.description: Canonical field metadata consumed by dynamic field loaders.

runtimeInputs.name: controlType
runtimeInputs.description: Control type resolved through ComponentRegistryService.

runtimeInputs.name: componentRegistry
runtimeInputs.description: Runtime registry for package-owned and host custom fields.

runtimeInputs.name: componentMetadataRegistry
runtimeInputs.description: Editorial discovery registry for field tooling.

editableTargets.description: A canonical FieldControlType token.
Alias resolved through core control-type normalization.
Package-owned editorial descriptor in src/lib/editorial/**.
Selector-to-controlType mapping used by config-first flows.
FieldMetadata capability path governed by @praxisui/core.
Runtime ComponentRegistryService coverage for a control type.
Metadata-editor and downstream tooling coverage for a control type.

handlerContract.description: Registers a package-owned control type in runtime and metadata registries using stable controlType and selector identities.
Adds a deterministic control alias that normalizes to one registered canonical controlType.
Removes one alias by normalized alias identity after validating replacement coverage for downstream configs.
Maps a selector to a deterministic controlType through FieldSelectorRegistry without using host-only selector conventions.
Validates editor/tooling discovery for one controlType separately from runtime rendering support.
Validates runtime registry and value-accessor coverage for one controlType without implying editor coverage.

validators.description: Package-owned control types must be unique and stable.
ComponentRegistryService must resolve the runtime component for the target controlType.
Control metadata must align with FieldMetadata semantics from @praxisui/core.
Aliases must normalize to a single canonical controlType.
Alias removal requires an existing alias target.
Alias removal must provide migration or replacement when downstream configs may still use it.
Destructive alias removal requires explicit confirmation.
Editorial descriptor updates require an existing package-owned descriptor.
Package-owned editorial changes must originate in src/lib/editorial/**, not host overrides.
Dynamic-form, metadata-editor and downstream tooling must discover the control metadata.
Metadata mappings must align with FIELD_METADATA_CAPABILITIES and control-family capabilities.
Runtime support and editor/tooling coverage must not diverge silently.
Coverage validation operations must include concrete evidence paths or spec names.
Selector mappings must resolve to one controlType through FieldSelectorRegistry and must not shadow package defaults implicitly.

roundTripRequirements: Runtime support, editorial descriptor, ComponentDocMeta and playground/catalog projection must remain aligned for package-owned fields.
Aliases must resolve through the canonical core normalization path and must not become host-only conventions.
Editor coverage and runtime coverage must be reported separately; runtime rendering alone is not sufficient evidence of editor/tooling support.

examples.request: Register a package-owned field control and make it runtime-resolvable.
Allow legacy alias my-control to resolve to myControl.
Remove obsolete alias old-control after migration.
Update friendly name and icon for a package-owned control.
Map pdx-my-control to myControl in the selector registry.
Publish a metadata capability path for option source mapping.
Prove that metadata editor and dynamic form can discover the control.
Prove runtime registry and value accessor coverage.
Mark a control supported because it renders, without editor metadata evidence.

controlProfiles.title: Text input controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for text-like controls, including inline and Material text inputs.

editableTargets.description: Text metadata paths such as placeholder, length limits, pattern, mask and autocomplete.

validators.description: Text constraints must preserve string field semantics and editor/runtime round-trip.

examples.request: Set placeholder and maximum length for a text input.

roundTripRequirements: Text constraints must round-trip through FieldMetadata and downstream tooling without becoming host-only placeholder state.

controlProfiles.title: Numeric controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for number, slider, range, rating and score controls.

editableTargets.description: Numeric metadata paths such as min, max, step, precision and display format.

validators.description: Numeric min, max, step and precision must be mutually valid for the target control.

examples.request: Set rating control to five points with half-step increments.

controlProfiles.title: Distance radius filter
controlProfiles.description: Profile for the inline radial distance filter, including units, semantic marks, presets, colors and governed draft confirmation.

editableTargets.description: Distance-radius metadata paths for value bounds, units, radial presentation, semantic marks, presets, adaptive sizing and overlay confirmation.

validators.description: Distance bounds, step, unit conversion, marks and presets must preserve ordered values in the canonical base unit.
Radial colors, opacity and adaptive overlay bounds must remain legible and theme-safe.

examples.request: Configure a kilometre distance range with semantic marks, presets and explicit Apply and Cancel actions.

roundTripRequirements: Distance values remain stored in distanceBaseUnit while the selected display unit remains metadata-driven.
Accent and semantic distance gradient stops round-trip independently through editor and runtime.
Explicit overlay mode keeps draft changes local until Apply and restores the baseline on Cancel.

controlProfiles.title: Currency controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for currency and price-range controls.

editableTargets.description: Currency metadata paths such as currency code, locale, precision and range mode.

validators.description: Currency controls require a valid ISO currency code and locale-aware formatting semantics.
Currency range bounds must be ordered and compatible with precision.

examples.request: Configure the currency field for Brazilian Real with two decimals.

controlProfiles.title: Select controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for select, autocomplete, async select, chips, status, sentiment and button-toggle controls.

editableTargets.description: Option source, local options, display/value fields, search and multi-select metadata paths.

validators.description: Option controls require canonical optionSource/options semantics, including cascade dependency mappings when present.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Configure select to store ids and display labels.

controlProfiles.title: Entity lookup controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for entity lookup controls that bind to remote resources.

editableTargets.description: Entity lookup metadata paths such as resourcePath, value/display fields and governed dialog search behavior.

validators.description: Entity lookup controls require canonical resource binding and stable value/display identity fields.
Option controls require canonical optionSource/options semantics, including cascade dependency mappings when present.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Bind the entity lookup to users, show the name while storing the id, use the inline trigger to change the selection, and provide governed advanced search.

controlProfiles.title: Tree select controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for hierarchical tree select controls.

editableTargets.description: Tree option metadata paths such as node id, parent id, children path, lazy loading and multi-selection.

validators.description: Tree controls require stable node identity and valid parent/children references.
Tree option sources must expose hierarchical data compatible with the configured node fields.

examples.request: Configure tree select with id, parentId and children fields.

controlProfiles.title: List and transfer controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for selection-list and transfer-list controls.

editableTargets.description: List option metadata paths such as options, selection mode, value field and ordering.

validators.description: List selection metadata must preserve stable option identity and selected value shape.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Configure transfer list to store ids and display labels with a maximum of three selected items.

controlProfiles.title: Date controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for single date, datetime, month, week, year and time picker controls.

editableTargets.description: Date/time metadata paths such as min, max, timezone, locale and format.

operations.title: Configure date or time field metadata

validators.description: Temporal min and max values must be valid and ordered for the target control granularity.
Timezone configuration must use a valid named timezone when the control is timezone-sensitive.

examples.request: Limit the date field to the current year in Sao Paulo timezone.

controlProfiles.title: Date range controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for date range, month range, year range, period and relative-period controls.

editableTargets.description: Date range metadata paths such as start/end field mapping, min/max and presets.

validators.description: Date range controls require distinct start/end field semantics and ordered submitted values.
Temporal min and max values must be valid and ordered for the target control granularity.

examples.request: Use createdFrom and createdTo as the date range field names.

controlProfiles.title: Time range controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for time range controls.

editableTargets.description: Time range metadata paths such as start/end fields, step minutes and timezone.

validators.description: Time range controls require distinct start/end field semantics and valid interval steps.
Timezone configuration must use a valid named timezone when the control is timezone-sensitive.

examples.request: Configure a time range with fifteen minute increments.

controlProfiles.title: Toggle controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for boolean toggle controls.

editableTargets.description: Boolean metadata paths such as true label, false label and default value.

validators.description: Toggle controls must preserve boolean value semantics and not serialize labels as submitted values.

examples.request: Set yes/no labels for a toggle without changing boolean submission.

controlProfiles.title: Color controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for color input, precision picker and inline semantic color controls.

editableTargets.description: Color metadata paths such as format, structured fallback palettes and a versioned governed palette reference.

validators.description: Color values and local palette entries must be valid CSS color expressions.
A governed palette reference requires a published palette key and must honor a pinned version or ETag when supplied.

examples.request: Use the published corporate status palette version 3 for state colors.

controlProfiles.title: Regional document controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for Brazilian CPF/CNPJ document input controls.

editableTargets.description: Canonical Brazilian document metadata paths for full inputs and explicitly semantic partial-search filters.

validators.description: Regional document controls must preserve canonical document type, version, display mask and optional full-document validation semantics.

examples.request: Accept CPF or CNPJ and validate the complete document.

controlProfiles.title: File upload controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for file upload controls that bind field metadata to accepted file types, limits and storage semantics.

editableTargets.description: File upload metadata paths such as accepted types, maximum file size, multiplicity and upload endpoint binding.

validators.description: File upload controls require explicit file type, size and multiplicity constraints before storage binding.
Upload endpoint metadata must map to the canonical host/backend upload contract instead of an ad hoc URL.

examples.request: Allow up to three PDF files with a five megabyte limit.

controlProfiles.title: Collection controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for repeatable collection controls that manage array-shaped field values.

editableTargets.description: Collection metadata paths such as item schema, minimum and maximum items, ordering and add/remove behavior.

validators.description: Collection controls require array-compatible item schema and stable item identity semantics.

examples.request: Configure a repeatable address collection with at least one item.

controlProfiles.title: Avatar controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for avatar controls that render image, initials, fallback identity metadata or governed avatar groups.

editableTargets.description: Avatar metadata paths such as image source, initials, fallback icon, size, tone, status, badge, group stack and accessible text.

validators.description: Avatar controls must keep display metadata separate from submitted domain value semantics.

examples.request: Use Ada initials with verified presence, a compact corporate badge and selected reviewer emphasis.

controlProfiles.title: Display and action controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for non-data or action-like field controls.

editableTargets.description: Display/action metadata paths such as label, icon, action id, loading state and presentation mode.

validators.description: Display/action controls must not silently mutate submitted domain data unless an explicit action contract exists.

examples.request: Configure a button field to trigger the refresh action.

controlProfiles.title: Field shell controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for wrapper/shell controls that host another field contract.

editableTargets.description: Shell metadata paths such as label, hint, error projection, layout and child control reference.

validators.description: Field shell controls must delegate child semantics to the child control profile instead of redefining them.

examples.request: Set shell label and delegate rendering to inline select.

authoringManifestProfiles.title: Toggle controls
authoringManifestProfiles.description: Profile for boolean toggle controls.

editableTargets.description: Boolean metadata paths such as true label, false label and default value.

validators.description: Toggle controls must preserve boolean value semantics and not serialize labels as submitted values.

examples.request: Set yes/no labels for a toggle without changing boolean submission.

runtimeInputs.name: fieldMetadata
runtimeInputs.description: Canonical field metadata consumed by dynamic field loaders.

runtimeInputs.name: controlType
runtimeInputs.description: Control type resolved through ComponentRegistryService.

runtimeInputs.name: componentRegistry
runtimeInputs.description: Runtime registry for package-owned and host custom fields.

runtimeInputs.name: componentMetadataRegistry
runtimeInputs.description: Editorial discovery registry for field tooling.

editableTargets.description: A canonical FieldControlType token.
Alias resolved through core control-type normalization.
Package-owned editorial descriptor in src/lib/editorial/**.
Selector-to-controlType mapping used by config-first flows.
FieldMetadata capability path governed by @praxisui/core.
Runtime ComponentRegistryService coverage for a control type.
Metadata-editor and downstream tooling coverage for a control type.

handlerContract.description: Registers a package-owned control type in runtime and metadata registries using stable controlType and selector identities.
Adds a deterministic control alias that normalizes to one registered canonical controlType.
Removes one alias by normalized alias identity after validating replacement coverage for downstream configs.
Maps a selector to a deterministic controlType through FieldSelectorRegistry without using host-only selector conventions.
Validates editor/tooling discovery for one controlType separately from runtime rendering support.
Validates runtime registry and value-accessor coverage for one controlType without implying editor coverage.

validators.description: Package-owned control types must be unique and stable.
ComponentRegistryService must resolve the runtime component for the target controlType.
Control metadata must align with FieldMetadata semantics from @praxisui/core.
Aliases must normalize to a single canonical controlType.
Alias removal requires an existing alias target.
Alias removal must provide migration or replacement when downstream configs may still use it.
Destructive alias removal requires explicit confirmation.
Editorial descriptor updates require an existing package-owned descriptor.
Package-owned editorial changes must originate in src/lib/editorial/**, not host overrides.
Dynamic-form, metadata-editor and downstream tooling must discover the control metadata.
Metadata mappings must align with FIELD_METADATA_CAPABILITIES and control-family capabilities.
Runtime support and editor/tooling coverage must not diverge silently.
Coverage validation operations must include concrete evidence paths or spec names.
Selector mappings must resolve to one controlType through FieldSelectorRegistry and must not shadow package defaults implicitly.

roundTripRequirements: Runtime support, editorial descriptor, ComponentDocMeta and playground/catalog projection must remain aligned for package-owned fields.
Aliases must resolve through the canonical core normalization path and must not become host-only conventions.
Editor coverage and runtime coverage must be reported separately; runtime rendering alone is not sufficient evidence of editor/tooling support.

examples.request: Register a package-owned field control and make it runtime-resolvable.
Allow legacy alias my-control to resolve to myControl.
Remove obsolete alias old-control after migration.
Update friendly name and icon for a package-owned control.
Map pdx-my-control to myControl in the selector registry.
Publish a metadata capability path for option source mapping.
Prove that metadata editor and dynamic form can discover the control.
Prove runtime registry and value accessor coverage.
Mark a control supported because it renders, without editor metadata evidence.

controlProfiles.title: Text input controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for text-like controls, including inline and Material text inputs.

editableTargets.description: Text metadata paths such as placeholder, length limits, pattern, mask and autocomplete.

validators.description: Text constraints must preserve string field semantics and editor/runtime round-trip.

examples.request: Set placeholder and maximum length for a text input.

roundTripRequirements: Text constraints must round-trip through FieldMetadata and downstream tooling without becoming host-only placeholder state.

controlProfiles.title: Numeric controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for number, slider, range, rating and score controls.

editableTargets.description: Numeric metadata paths such as min, max, step, precision and display format.

validators.description: Numeric min, max, step and precision must be mutually valid for the target control.

examples.request: Set rating control to five points with half-step increments.

controlProfiles.title: Distance radius filter
controlProfiles.description: Profile for the inline radial distance filter, including units, semantic marks, presets, colors and governed draft confirmation.

editableTargets.description: Distance-radius metadata paths for value bounds, units, radial presentation, semantic marks, presets, adaptive sizing and overlay confirmation.

validators.description: Distance bounds, step, unit conversion, marks and presets must preserve ordered values in the canonical base unit.
Radial colors, opacity and adaptive overlay bounds must remain legible and theme-safe.

examples.request: Configure a kilometre distance range with semantic marks, presets and explicit Apply and Cancel actions.

roundTripRequirements: Distance values remain stored in distanceBaseUnit while the selected display unit remains metadata-driven.
Accent and semantic distance gradient stops round-trip independently through editor and runtime.
Explicit overlay mode keeps draft changes local until Apply and restores the baseline on Cancel.

controlProfiles.title: Currency controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for currency and price-range controls.

editableTargets.description: Currency metadata paths such as currency code, locale, precision and range mode.

validators.description: Currency controls require a valid ISO currency code and locale-aware formatting semantics.
Currency range bounds must be ordered and compatible with precision.

examples.request: Configure the currency field for Brazilian Real with two decimals.

controlProfiles.title: Select controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for select, autocomplete, async select, chips, status, sentiment and button-toggle controls.

editableTargets.description: Option source, local options, display/value fields, search and multi-select metadata paths.

validators.description: Option controls require canonical optionSource/options semantics, including cascade dependency mappings when present.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Configure select to store ids and display labels.

controlProfiles.title: Entity lookup controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for entity lookup controls that bind to remote resources.

editableTargets.description: Entity lookup metadata paths such as resourcePath, value/display fields and governed dialog search behavior.

validators.description: Entity lookup controls require canonical resource binding and stable value/display identity fields.
Option controls require canonical optionSource/options semantics, including cascade dependency mappings when present.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Bind the entity lookup to users, show the name while storing the id, use the inline trigger to change the selection, and provide governed advanced search.

controlProfiles.title: Tree select controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for hierarchical tree select controls.

editableTargets.description: Tree option metadata paths such as node id, parent id, children path, lazy loading and multi-selection.

validators.description: Tree controls require stable node identity and valid parent/children references.
Tree option sources must expose hierarchical data compatible with the configured node fields.

examples.request: Configure tree select with id, parentId and children fields.

controlProfiles.title: List and transfer controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for selection-list and transfer-list controls.

editableTargets.description: List option metadata paths such as options, selection mode, value field and ordering.

validators.description: List selection metadata must preserve stable option identity and selected value shape.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Configure transfer list to store ids and display labels with a maximum of three selected items.

controlProfiles.title: Date controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for single date, datetime, month, week, year and time picker controls.

editableTargets.description: Date/time metadata paths such as min, max, timezone, locale and format.

operations.title: Configure date or time field metadata

validators.description: Temporal min and max values must be valid and ordered for the target control granularity.
Timezone configuration must use a valid named timezone when the control is timezone-sensitive.

examples.request: Limit the date field to the current year in Sao Paulo timezone.

controlProfiles.title: Date range controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for date range, month range, year range, period and relative-period controls.

editableTargets.description: Date range metadata paths such as start/end field mapping, min/max and presets.

validators.description: Date range controls require distinct start/end field semantics and ordered submitted values.
Temporal min and max values must be valid and ordered for the target control granularity.

examples.request: Use createdFrom and createdTo as the date range field names.

controlProfiles.title: Time range controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for time range controls.

editableTargets.description: Time range metadata paths such as start/end fields, step minutes and timezone.

validators.description: Time range controls require distinct start/end field semantics and valid interval steps.
Timezone configuration must use a valid named timezone when the control is timezone-sensitive.

examples.request: Configure a time range with fifteen minute increments.

controlProfiles.title: Toggle controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for boolean toggle controls.

editableTargets.description: Boolean metadata paths such as true label, false label and default value.

validators.description: Toggle controls must preserve boolean value semantics and not serialize labels as submitted values.

examples.request: Set yes/no labels for a toggle without changing boolean submission.

controlProfiles.title: Color controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for color input, precision picker and inline semantic color controls.

editableTargets.description: Color metadata paths such as format, structured fallback palettes and a versioned governed palette reference.

validators.description: Color values and local palette entries must be valid CSS color expressions.
A governed palette reference requires a published palette key and must honor a pinned version or ETag when supplied.

examples.request: Use the published corporate status palette version 3 for state colors.

controlProfiles.title: Regional document controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for Brazilian CPF/CNPJ document input controls.

editableTargets.description: Canonical Brazilian document metadata paths for full inputs and explicitly semantic partial-search filters.

validators.description: Regional document controls must preserve canonical document type, version, display mask and optional full-document validation semantics.

examples.request: Accept CPF or CNPJ and validate the complete document.

controlProfiles.title: File upload controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for file upload controls that bind field metadata to accepted file types, limits and storage semantics.

editableTargets.description: File upload metadata paths such as accepted types, maximum file size, multiplicity and upload endpoint binding.

validators.description: File upload controls require explicit file type, size and multiplicity constraints before storage binding.
Upload endpoint metadata must map to the canonical host/backend upload contract instead of an ad hoc URL.

examples.request: Allow up to three PDF files with a five megabyte limit.

controlProfiles.title: Collection controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for repeatable collection controls that manage array-shaped field values.

editableTargets.description: Collection metadata paths such as item schema, minimum and maximum items, ordering and add/remove behavior.

validators.description: Collection controls require array-compatible item schema and stable item identity semantics.

examples.request: Configure a repeatable address collection with at least one item.

controlProfiles.title: Avatar controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for avatar controls that render image, initials, fallback identity metadata or governed avatar groups.

editableTargets.description: Avatar metadata paths such as image source, initials, fallback icon, size, tone, status, badge, group stack and accessible text.

validators.description: Avatar controls must keep display metadata separate from submitted domain value semantics.

examples.request: Use Ada initials with verified presence, a compact corporate badge and selected reviewer emphasis.

controlProfiles.title: Display and action controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for non-data or action-like field controls.

editableTargets.description: Display/action metadata paths such as label, icon, action id, loading state and presentation mode.

validators.description: Display/action controls must not silently mutate submitted domain data unless an explicit action contract exists.

examples.request: Configure a button field to trigger the refresh action.

controlProfiles.title: Field shell controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for wrapper/shell controls that host another field contract.

editableTargets.description: Shell metadata paths such as label, hint, error projection, layout and child control reference.

validators.description: Field shell controls must delegate child semantics to the child control profile instead of redefining them.

examples.request: Set shell label and delegate rendering to inline select.

authoringManifestProfiles.title: Numeric controls
authoringManifestProfiles.description: Profile for number, slider, range, rating and score controls.

editableTargets.description: Numeric metadata paths such as min, max, step, precision and display format.

validators.description: Numeric min, max, step and precision must be mutually valid for the target control.

examples.request: Set rating control to five points with half-step increments.

runtimeInputs.name: fieldMetadata
runtimeInputs.description: Canonical field metadata consumed by dynamic field loaders.

runtimeInputs.name: controlType
runtimeInputs.description: Control type resolved through ComponentRegistryService.

runtimeInputs.name: componentRegistry
runtimeInputs.description: Runtime registry for package-owned and host custom fields.

runtimeInputs.name: componentMetadataRegistry
runtimeInputs.description: Editorial discovery registry for field tooling.

editableTargets.description: A canonical FieldControlType token.
Alias resolved through core control-type normalization.
Package-owned editorial descriptor in src/lib/editorial/**.
Selector-to-controlType mapping used by config-first flows.
FieldMetadata capability path governed by @praxisui/core.
Runtime ComponentRegistryService coverage for a control type.
Metadata-editor and downstream tooling coverage for a control type.

handlerContract.description: Registers a package-owned control type in runtime and metadata registries using stable controlType and selector identities.
Adds a deterministic control alias that normalizes to one registered canonical controlType.
Removes one alias by normalized alias identity after validating replacement coverage for downstream configs.
Maps a selector to a deterministic controlType through FieldSelectorRegistry without using host-only selector conventions.
Validates editor/tooling discovery for one controlType separately from runtime rendering support.
Validates runtime registry and value-accessor coverage for one controlType without implying editor coverage.

validators.description: Package-owned control types must be unique and stable.
ComponentRegistryService must resolve the runtime component for the target controlType.
Control metadata must align with FieldMetadata semantics from @praxisui/core.
Aliases must normalize to a single canonical controlType.
Alias removal requires an existing alias target.
Alias removal must provide migration or replacement when downstream configs may still use it.
Destructive alias removal requires explicit confirmation.
Editorial descriptor updates require an existing package-owned descriptor.
Package-owned editorial changes must originate in src/lib/editorial/**, not host overrides.
Dynamic-form, metadata-editor and downstream tooling must discover the control metadata.
Metadata mappings must align with FIELD_METADATA_CAPABILITIES and control-family capabilities.
Runtime support and editor/tooling coverage must not diverge silently.
Coverage validation operations must include concrete evidence paths or spec names.
Selector mappings must resolve to one controlType through FieldSelectorRegistry and must not shadow package defaults implicitly.

roundTripRequirements: Runtime support, editorial descriptor, ComponentDocMeta and playground/catalog projection must remain aligned for package-owned fields.
Aliases must resolve through the canonical core normalization path and must not become host-only conventions.
Editor coverage and runtime coverage must be reported separately; runtime rendering alone is not sufficient evidence of editor/tooling support.

examples.request: Register a package-owned field control and make it runtime-resolvable.
Allow legacy alias my-control to resolve to myControl.
Remove obsolete alias old-control after migration.
Update friendly name and icon for a package-owned control.
Map pdx-my-control to myControl in the selector registry.
Publish a metadata capability path for option source mapping.
Prove that metadata editor and dynamic form can discover the control.
Prove runtime registry and value accessor coverage.
Mark a control supported because it renders, without editor metadata evidence.

controlProfiles.title: Text input controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for text-like controls, including inline and Material text inputs.

editableTargets.description: Text metadata paths such as placeholder, length limits, pattern, mask and autocomplete.

validators.description: Text constraints must preserve string field semantics and editor/runtime round-trip.

examples.request: Set placeholder and maximum length for a text input.

roundTripRequirements: Text constraints must round-trip through FieldMetadata and downstream tooling without becoming host-only placeholder state.

controlProfiles.title: Numeric controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for number, slider, range, rating and score controls.

editableTargets.description: Numeric metadata paths such as min, max, step, precision and display format.

validators.description: Numeric min, max, step and precision must be mutually valid for the target control.

examples.request: Set rating control to five points with half-step increments.

controlProfiles.title: Distance radius filter
controlProfiles.description: Profile for the inline radial distance filter, including units, semantic marks, presets, colors and governed draft confirmation.

editableTargets.description: Distance-radius metadata paths for value bounds, units, radial presentation, semantic marks, presets, adaptive sizing and overlay confirmation.

validators.description: Distance bounds, step, unit conversion, marks and presets must preserve ordered values in the canonical base unit.
Radial colors, opacity and adaptive overlay bounds must remain legible and theme-safe.

examples.request: Configure a kilometre distance range with semantic marks, presets and explicit Apply and Cancel actions.

roundTripRequirements: Distance values remain stored in distanceBaseUnit while the selected display unit remains metadata-driven.
Accent and semantic distance gradient stops round-trip independently through editor and runtime.
Explicit overlay mode keeps draft changes local until Apply and restores the baseline on Cancel.

controlProfiles.title: Currency controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for currency and price-range controls.

editableTargets.description: Currency metadata paths such as currency code, locale, precision and range mode.

validators.description: Currency controls require a valid ISO currency code and locale-aware formatting semantics.
Currency range bounds must be ordered and compatible with precision.

examples.request: Configure the currency field for Brazilian Real with two decimals.

controlProfiles.title: Select controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for select, autocomplete, async select, chips, status, sentiment and button-toggle controls.

editableTargets.description: Option source, local options, display/value fields, search and multi-select metadata paths.

validators.description: Option controls require canonical optionSource/options semantics, including cascade dependency mappings when present.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Configure select to store ids and display labels.

controlProfiles.title: Entity lookup controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for entity lookup controls that bind to remote resources.

editableTargets.description: Entity lookup metadata paths such as resourcePath, value/display fields and governed dialog search behavior.

validators.description: Entity lookup controls require canonical resource binding and stable value/display identity fields.
Option controls require canonical optionSource/options semantics, including cascade dependency mappings when present.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Bind the entity lookup to users, show the name while storing the id, use the inline trigger to change the selection, and provide governed advanced search.

controlProfiles.title: Tree select controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for hierarchical tree select controls.

editableTargets.description: Tree option metadata paths such as node id, parent id, children path, lazy loading and multi-selection.

validators.description: Tree controls require stable node identity and valid parent/children references.
Tree option sources must expose hierarchical data compatible with the configured node fields.

examples.request: Configure tree select with id, parentId and children fields.

controlProfiles.title: List and transfer controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for selection-list and transfer-list controls.

editableTargets.description: List option metadata paths such as options, selection mode, value field and ordering.

validators.description: List selection metadata must preserve stable option identity and selected value shape.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Configure transfer list to store ids and display labels with a maximum of three selected items.

controlProfiles.title: Date controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for single date, datetime, month, week, year and time picker controls.

editableTargets.description: Date/time metadata paths such as min, max, timezone, locale and format.

operations.title: Configure date or time field metadata

validators.description: Temporal min and max values must be valid and ordered for the target control granularity.
Timezone configuration must use a valid named timezone when the control is timezone-sensitive.

examples.request: Limit the date field to the current year in Sao Paulo timezone.

controlProfiles.title: Date range controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for date range, month range, year range, period and relative-period controls.

editableTargets.description: Date range metadata paths such as start/end field mapping, min/max and presets.

validators.description: Date range controls require distinct start/end field semantics and ordered submitted values.
Temporal min and max values must be valid and ordered for the target control granularity.

examples.request: Use createdFrom and createdTo as the date range field names.

controlProfiles.title: Time range controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for time range controls.

editableTargets.description: Time range metadata paths such as start/end fields, step minutes and timezone.

validators.description: Time range controls require distinct start/end field semantics and valid interval steps.
Timezone configuration must use a valid named timezone when the control is timezone-sensitive.

examples.request: Configure a time range with fifteen minute increments.

controlProfiles.title: Toggle controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for boolean toggle controls.

editableTargets.description: Boolean metadata paths such as true label, false label and default value.

validators.description: Toggle controls must preserve boolean value semantics and not serialize labels as submitted values.

examples.request: Set yes/no labels for a toggle without changing boolean submission.

controlProfiles.title: Color controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for color input, precision picker and inline semantic color controls.

editableTargets.description: Color metadata paths such as format, structured fallback palettes and a versioned governed palette reference.

validators.description: Color values and local palette entries must be valid CSS color expressions.
A governed palette reference requires a published palette key and must honor a pinned version or ETag when supplied.

examples.request: Use the published corporate status palette version 3 for state colors.

controlProfiles.title: Regional document controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for Brazilian CPF/CNPJ document input controls.

editableTargets.description: Canonical Brazilian document metadata paths for full inputs and explicitly semantic partial-search filters.

validators.description: Regional document controls must preserve canonical document type, version, display mask and optional full-document validation semantics.

examples.request: Accept CPF or CNPJ and validate the complete document.

controlProfiles.title: File upload controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for file upload controls that bind field metadata to accepted file types, limits and storage semantics.

editableTargets.description: File upload metadata paths such as accepted types, maximum file size, multiplicity and upload endpoint binding.

validators.description: File upload controls require explicit file type, size and multiplicity constraints before storage binding.
Upload endpoint metadata must map to the canonical host/backend upload contract instead of an ad hoc URL.

examples.request: Allow up to three PDF files with a five megabyte limit.

controlProfiles.title: Collection controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for repeatable collection controls that manage array-shaped field values.

editableTargets.description: Collection metadata paths such as item schema, minimum and maximum items, ordering and add/remove behavior.

validators.description: Collection controls require array-compatible item schema and stable item identity semantics.

examples.request: Configure a repeatable address collection with at least one item.

controlProfiles.title: Avatar controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for avatar controls that render image, initials, fallback identity metadata or governed avatar groups.

editableTargets.description: Avatar metadata paths such as image source, initials, fallback icon, size, tone, status, badge, group stack and accessible text.

validators.description: Avatar controls must keep display metadata separate from submitted domain value semantics.

examples.request: Use Ada initials with verified presence, a compact corporate badge and selected reviewer emphasis.

controlProfiles.title: Display and action controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for non-data or action-like field controls.

editableTargets.description: Display/action metadata paths such as label, icon, action id, loading state and presentation mode.

validators.description: Display/action controls must not silently mutate submitted domain data unless an explicit action contract exists.

examples.request: Configure a button field to trigger the refresh action.

controlProfiles.title: Field shell controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for wrapper/shell controls that host another field contract.

editableTargets.description: Shell metadata paths such as label, hint, error projection, layout and child control reference.

validators.description: Field shell controls must delegate child semantics to the child control profile instead of redefining them.

examples.request: Set shell label and delegate rendering to inline select.

authoringManifestProfiles.title: Text input controls
authoringManifestProfiles.description: Profile for text-like controls, including inline and Material text inputs.

editableTargets.description: Text metadata paths such as placeholder, length limits, pattern, mask and autocomplete.

validators.description: Text constraints must preserve string field semantics and editor/runtime round-trip.

examples.request: Set placeholder and maximum length for a text input.

roundTripRequirements: Text constraints must round-trip through FieldMetadata and downstream tooling without becoming host-only placeholder state.

Control metadata must align with FieldMetadata semantics from @praxisui/core.
Aliases must normalize to a single canonical controlType.
Alias removal requires an existing alias target.
Alias removal must provide migration or replacement when downstream configs may still use it.
Destructive alias removal requires explicit confirmation.
Editorial descriptor updates require an existing package-owned descriptor.
Package-owned editorial changes must originate in src/lib/editorial/**, not host overrides.
Dynamic-form, metadata-editor and downstream tooling must discover the control metadata.
Metadata mappings must align with FIELD_METADATA_CAPABILITIES and control-family capabilities.
Runtime support and editor/tooling coverage must not diverge silently.
Coverage validation operations must include concrete evidence paths or spec names.
Selector mappings must resolve to one controlType through FieldSelectorRegistry and must not shadow package defaults implicitly.

roundTripRequirements: Runtime support, editorial descriptor, ComponentDocMeta and playground/catalog projection must remain aligned for package-owned fields.
Aliases must resolve through the canonical core normalization path and must not become host-only conventions.
Editor coverage and runtime coverage must be reported separately; runtime rendering alone is not sufficient evidence of editor/tooling support.

examples.request: Register a package-owned field control and make it runtime-resolvable.
Allow legacy alias my-control to resolve to myControl.
Remove obsolete alias old-control after migration.
Update friendly name and icon for a package-owned control.
Map pdx-my-control to myControl in the selector registry.
Publish a metadata capability path for option source mapping.
Prove that metadata editor and dynamic form can discover the control.
Prove runtime registry and value accessor coverage.
Mark a control supported because it renders, without editor metadata evidence.

controlProfiles.title: Text input controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for text-like controls, including inline and Material text inputs.

editableTargets.description: Text metadata paths such as placeholder, length limits, pattern, mask and autocomplete.

validators.description: Text constraints must preserve string field semantics and editor/runtime round-trip.

examples.request: Set placeholder and maximum length for a text input.

roundTripRequirements: Text constraints must round-trip through FieldMetadata and downstream tooling without becoming host-only placeholder state.

controlProfiles.title: Numeric controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for number, slider, range, rating and score controls.

editableTargets.description: Numeric metadata paths such as min, max, step, precision and display format.

validators.description: Numeric min, max, step and precision must be mutually valid for the target control.

examples.request: Set rating control to five points with half-step increments.

controlProfiles.title: Distance radius filter
controlProfiles.description: Profile for the inline radial distance filter, including units, semantic marks, presets, colors and governed draft confirmation.

editableTargets.description: Distance-radius metadata paths for value bounds, units, radial presentation, semantic marks, presets, adaptive sizing and overlay confirmation.

validators.description: Distance bounds, step, unit conversion, marks and presets must preserve ordered values in the canonical base unit.
Radial colors, opacity and adaptive overlay bounds must remain legible and theme-safe.

examples.request: Configure a kilometre distance range with semantic marks, presets and explicit Apply and Cancel actions.

roundTripRequirements: Distance values remain stored in distanceBaseUnit while the selected display unit remains metadata-driven.
Accent and semantic distance gradient stops round-trip independently through editor and runtime.
Explicit overlay mode keeps draft changes local until Apply and restores the baseline on Cancel.

controlProfiles.title: Currency controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for currency and price-range controls.

editableTargets.description: Currency metadata paths such as currency code, locale, precision and range mode.

validators.description: Currency controls require a valid ISO currency code and locale-aware formatting semantics.
Currency range bounds must be ordered and compatible with precision.

examples.request: Configure the currency field for Brazilian Real with two decimals.

controlProfiles.title: Select controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for select, autocomplete, async select, chips, status, sentiment and button-toggle controls.

editableTargets.description: Option source, local options, display/value fields, search and multi-select metadata paths.

validators.description: Option controls require canonical optionSource/options semantics, including cascade dependency mappings when present.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Configure select to store ids and display labels.

controlProfiles.title: Entity lookup controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for entity lookup controls that bind to remote resources.

editableTargets.description: Entity lookup metadata paths such as resourcePath, value/display fields and governed dialog search behavior.

validators.description: Entity lookup controls require canonical resource binding and stable value/display identity fields.
Option controls require canonical optionSource/options semantics, including cascade dependency mappings when present.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Bind the entity lookup to users, show the name while storing the id, use the inline trigger to change the selection, and provide governed advanced search.

controlProfiles.title: Tree select controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for hierarchical tree select controls.

editableTargets.description: Tree option metadata paths such as node id, parent id, children path, lazy loading and multi-selection.

validators.description: Tree controls require stable node identity and valid parent/children references.
Tree option sources must expose hierarchical data compatible with the configured node fields.

examples.request: Configure tree select with id, parentId and children fields.

controlProfiles.title: List and transfer controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for selection-list and transfer-list controls.

editableTargets.description: List option metadata paths such as options, selection mode, value field and ordering.

validators.description: List selection metadata must preserve stable option identity and selected value shape.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Configure transfer list to store ids and display labels with a maximum of three selected items.

controlProfiles.title: Date controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for single date, datetime, month, week, year and time picker controls.

editableTargets.description: Date/time metadata paths such as min, max, timezone, locale and format.

operations.title: Configure date or time field metadata

validators.description: Temporal min and max values must be valid and ordered for the target control granularity.
Timezone configuration must use a valid named timezone when the control is timezone-sensitive.

examples.request: Limit the date field to the current year in Sao Paulo timezone.

controlProfiles.title: Date range controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for date range, month range, year range, period and relative-period controls.

editableTargets.description: Date range metadata paths such as start/end field mapping, min/max and presets.

validators.description: Date range controls require distinct start/end field semantics and ordered submitted values.
Temporal min and max values must be valid and ordered for the target control granularity.

examples.request: Use createdFrom and createdTo as the date range field names.

controlProfiles.title: Time range controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for time range controls.

editableTargets.description: Time range metadata paths such as start/end fields, step minutes and timezone.

validators.description: Time range controls require distinct start/end field semantics and valid interval steps.
Timezone configuration must use a valid named timezone when the control is timezone-sensitive.

examples.request: Configure a time range with fifteen minute increments.

controlProfiles.title: Toggle controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for boolean toggle controls.

editableTargets.description: Boolean metadata paths such as true label, false label and default value.

validators.description: Toggle controls must preserve boolean value semantics and not serialize labels as submitted values.

examples.request: Set yes/no labels for a toggle without changing boolean submission.

controlProfiles.title: Color controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for color input, precision picker and inline semantic color controls.

editableTargets.description: Color metadata paths such as format, structured fallback palettes and a versioned governed palette reference.

validators.description: Color values and local palette entries must be valid CSS color expressions.
A governed palette reference requires a published palette key and must honor a pinned version or ETag when supplied.

examples.request: Use the published corporate status palette version 3 for state colors.

controlProfiles.title: Regional document controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for Brazilian CPF/CNPJ document input controls.

editableTargets.description: Canonical Brazilian document metadata paths for full inputs and explicitly semantic partial-search filters.

validators.description: Regional document controls must preserve canonical document type, version, display mask and optional full-document validation semantics.

examples.request: Accept CPF or CNPJ and validate the complete document.

controlProfiles.title: File upload controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for file upload controls that bind field metadata to accepted file types, limits and storage semantics.

editableTargets.description: File upload metadata paths such as accepted types, maximum file size, multiplicity and upload endpoint binding.

validators.description: File upload controls require explicit file type, size and multiplicity constraints before storage binding.
Upload endpoint metadata must map to the canonical host/backend upload contract instead of an ad hoc URL.

examples.request: Allow up to three PDF files with a five megabyte limit.

controlProfiles.title: Collection controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for repeatable collection controls that manage array-shaped field values.

editableTargets.description: Collection metadata paths such as item schema, minimum and maximum items, ordering and add/remove behavior.

validators.description: Collection controls require array-compatible item schema and stable item identity semantics.

examples.request: Configure a repeatable address collection with at least one item.

controlProfiles.title: Avatar controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for avatar controls that render image, initials, fallback identity metadata or governed avatar groups.

editableTargets.description: Avatar metadata paths such as image source, initials, fallback icon, size, tone, status, badge, group stack and accessible text.

validators.description: Avatar controls must keep display metadata separate from submitted domain value semantics.

examples.request: Use Ada initials with verified presence, a compact corporate badge and selected reviewer emphasis.

controlProfiles.title: Display and action controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for non-data or action-like field controls.

editableTargets.description: Display/action metadata paths such as label, icon, action id, loading state and presentation mode.

validators.description: Display/action controls must not silently mutate submitted domain data unless an explicit action contract exists.

examples.request: Configure a button field to trigger the refresh action.

controlProfiles.title: Field shell controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for wrapper/shell controls that host another field contract.

editableTargets.description: Shell metadata paths such as label, hint, error projection, layout and child control reference.

validators.description: Field shell controls must delegate child semantics to the child control profile instead of redefining them.

examples.request: Set shell label and delegate rendering to inline select.

authoringManifestProfiles.title: Time range controls
authoringManifestProfiles.description: Profile for time range controls.

editableTargets.description: Time range metadata paths such as start/end fields, step minutes and timezone.

validators.description: Time range controls require distinct start/end field semantics and valid interval steps.
Timezone configuration must use a valid named timezone when the control is timezone-sensitive.

examples.request: Configure a time range with fifteen minute increments.

runtimeInputs.name: fieldMetadata
runtimeInputs.description: Canonical field metadata consumed by dynamic field loaders.

runtimeInputs.name: controlType
runtimeInputs.description: Control type resolved through ComponentRegistryService.

runtimeInputs.name: componentRegistry
runtimeInputs.description: Runtime registry for package-owned and host custom fields.

runtimeInputs.name: componentMetadataRegistry
runtimeInputs.description: Editorial discovery registry for field tooling.

editableTargets.description: A canonical FieldControlType token.
Alias resolved through core control-type normalization.
Package-owned editorial descriptor in src/lib/editorial/**.
Selector-to-controlType mapping used by config-first flows.
FieldMetadata capability path governed by @praxisui/core.
Runtime ComponentRegistryService coverage for a control type.
Metadata-editor and downstream tooling coverage for a control type.

handlerContract.description: Registers a package-owned control type in runtime and metadata registries using stable controlType and selector identities.
Adds a deterministic control alias that normalizes to one registered canonical controlType.
Removes one alias by normalized alias identity after validating replacement coverage for downstream configs.
Maps a selector to a deterministic controlType through FieldSelectorRegistry without using host-only selector conventions.
Validates editor/tooling discovery for one controlType separately from runtime rendering support.
Validates runtime registry and value-accessor coverage for one controlType without implying editor coverage.

validators.description: Package-owned control types must be unique and stable.
ComponentRegistryService must resolve the runtime component for the target controlType.
Control metadata must align with FieldMetadata semantics from @praxisui/core.
Aliases must normalize to a single canonical controlType.
Alias removal requires an existing alias target.
Alias removal must provide migration or replacement when downstream configs may still use it.
Destructive alias removal requires explicit confirmation.
Editorial descriptor updates require an existing package-owned descriptor.
Package-owned editorial changes must originate in src/lib/editorial/**, not host overrides.
Dynamic-form, metadata-editor and downstream tooling must discover the control metadata.
Metadata mappings must align with FIELD_METADATA_CAPABILITIES and control-family capabilities.
Runtime support and editor/tooling coverage must not diverge silently.
Coverage validation operations must include concrete evidence paths or spec names.
Selector mappings must resolve to one controlType through FieldSelectorRegistry and must not shadow package defaults implicitly.

roundTripRequirements: Runtime support, editorial descriptor, ComponentDocMeta and playground/catalog projection must remain aligned for package-owned fields.
Aliases must resolve through the canonical core normalization path and must not become host-only conventions.
Editor coverage and runtime coverage must be reported separately; runtime rendering alone is not sufficient evidence of editor/tooling support.

examples.request: Register a package-owned field control and make it runtime-resolvable.
Allow legacy alias my-control to resolve to myControl.
Remove obsolete alias old-control after migration.
Update friendly name and icon for a package-owned control.
Map pdx-my-control to myControl in the selector registry.
Publish a metadata capability path for option source mapping.
Prove that metadata editor and dynamic form can discover the control.
Prove runtime registry and value accessor coverage.
Mark a control supported because it renders, without editor metadata evidence.

controlProfiles.title: Text input controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for text-like controls, including inline and Material text inputs.

editableTargets.description: Text metadata paths such as placeholder, length limits, pattern, mask and autocomplete.

validators.description: Text constraints must preserve string field semantics and editor/runtime round-trip.

examples.request: Set placeholder and maximum length for a text input.

roundTripRequirements: Text constraints must round-trip through FieldMetadata and downstream tooling without becoming host-only placeholder state.

controlProfiles.title: Numeric controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for number, slider, range, rating and score controls.

editableTargets.description: Numeric metadata paths such as min, max, step, precision and display format.

validators.description: Numeric min, max, step and precision must be mutually valid for the target control.

examples.request: Set rating control to five points with half-step increments.

controlProfiles.title: Distance radius filter
controlProfiles.description: Profile for the inline radial distance filter, including units, semantic marks, presets, colors and governed draft confirmation.

editableTargets.description: Distance-radius metadata paths for value bounds, units, radial presentation, semantic marks, presets, adaptive sizing and overlay confirmation.

validators.description: Distance bounds, step, unit conversion, marks and presets must preserve ordered values in the canonical base unit.
Radial colors, opacity and adaptive overlay bounds must remain legible and theme-safe.

examples.request: Configure a kilometre distance range with semantic marks, presets and explicit Apply and Cancel actions.

roundTripRequirements: Distance values remain stored in distanceBaseUnit while the selected display unit remains metadata-driven.
Accent and semantic distance gradient stops round-trip independently through editor and runtime.
Explicit overlay mode keeps draft changes local until Apply and restores the baseline on Cancel.

controlProfiles.title: Currency controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for currency and price-range controls.

editableTargets.description: Currency metadata paths such as currency code, locale, precision and range mode.

validators.description: Currency controls require a valid ISO currency code and locale-aware formatting semantics.
Currency range bounds must be ordered and compatible with precision.

examples.request: Configure the currency field for Brazilian Real with two decimals.

controlProfiles.title: Select controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for select, autocomplete, async select, chips, status, sentiment and button-toggle controls.

editableTargets.description: Option source, local options, display/value fields, search and multi-select metadata paths.

validators.description: Option controls require canonical optionSource/options semantics, including cascade dependency mappings when present.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Configure select to store ids and display labels.

controlProfiles.title: Entity lookup controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for entity lookup controls that bind to remote resources.

editableTargets.description: Entity lookup metadata paths such as resourcePath, value/display fields and governed dialog search behavior.

validators.description: Entity lookup controls require canonical resource binding and stable value/display identity fields.
Option controls require canonical optionSource/options semantics, including cascade dependency mappings when present.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Bind the entity lookup to users, show the name while storing the id, use the inline trigger to change the selection, and provide governed advanced search.

controlProfiles.title: Tree select controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for hierarchical tree select controls.

editableTargets.description: Tree option metadata paths such as node id, parent id, children path, lazy loading and multi-selection.

validators.description: Tree controls require stable node identity and valid parent/children references.
Tree option sources must expose hierarchical data compatible with the configured node fields.

examples.request: Configure tree select with id, parentId and children fields.

controlProfiles.title: List and transfer controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for selection-list and transfer-list controls.

editableTargets.description: List option metadata paths such as options, selection mode, value field and ordering.

validators.description: List selection metadata must preserve stable option identity and selected value shape.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Configure transfer list to store ids and display labels with a maximum of three selected items.

controlProfiles.title: Date controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for single date, datetime, month, week, year and time picker controls.

editableTargets.description: Date/time metadata paths such as min, max, timezone, locale and format.

operations.title: Configure date or time field metadata

validators.description: Temporal min and max values must be valid and ordered for the target control granularity.
Timezone configuration must use a valid named timezone when the control is timezone-sensitive.

examples.request: Limit the date field to the current year in Sao Paulo timezone.

controlProfiles.title: Date range controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for date range, month range, year range, period and relative-period controls.

editableTargets.description: Date range metadata paths such as start/end field mapping, min/max and presets.

validators.description: Date range controls require distinct start/end field semantics and ordered submitted values.
Temporal min and max values must be valid and ordered for the target control granularity.

examples.request: Use createdFrom and createdTo as the date range field names.

controlProfiles.title: Time range controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for time range controls.

editableTargets.description: Time range metadata paths such as start/end fields, step minutes and timezone.

validators.description: Time range controls require distinct start/end field semantics and valid interval steps.
Timezone configuration must use a valid named timezone when the control is timezone-sensitive.

examples.request: Configure a time range with fifteen minute increments.

controlProfiles.title: Toggle controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for boolean toggle controls.

editableTargets.description: Boolean metadata paths such as true label, false label and default value.

validators.description: Toggle controls must preserve boolean value semantics and not serialize labels as submitted values.

examples.request: Set yes/no labels for a toggle without changing boolean submission.

controlProfiles.title: Color controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for color input, precision picker and inline semantic color controls.

editableTargets.description: Color metadata paths such as format, structured fallback palettes and a versioned governed palette reference.

validators.description: Color values and local palette entries must be valid CSS color expressions.
A governed palette reference requires a published palette key and must honor a pinned version or ETag when supplied.

examples.request: Use the published corporate status palette version 3 for state colors.

controlProfiles.title: Regional document controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for Brazilian CPF/CNPJ document input controls.

editableTargets.description: Canonical Brazilian document metadata paths for full inputs and explicitly semantic partial-search filters.

validators.description: Regional document controls must preserve canonical document type, version, display mask and optional full-document validation semantics.

examples.request: Accept CPF or CNPJ and validate the complete document.

controlProfiles.title: File upload controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for file upload controls that bind field metadata to accepted file types, limits and storage semantics.

editableTargets.description: File upload metadata paths such as accepted types, maximum file size, multiplicity and upload endpoint binding.

validators.description: File upload controls require explicit file type, size and multiplicity constraints before storage binding.
Upload endpoint metadata must map to the canonical host/backend upload contract instead of an ad hoc URL.

examples.request: Allow up to three PDF files with a five megabyte limit.

controlProfiles.title: Collection controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for repeatable collection controls that manage array-shaped field values.

editableTargets.description: Collection metadata paths such as item schema, minimum and maximum items, ordering and add/remove behavior.

validators.description: Collection controls require array-compatible item schema and stable item identity semantics.

examples.request: Configure a repeatable address collection with at least one item.

controlProfiles.title: Avatar controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for avatar controls that render image, initials, fallback identity metadata or governed avatar groups.

editableTargets.description: Avatar metadata paths such as image source, initials, fallback icon, size, tone, status, badge, group stack and accessible text.

validators.description: Avatar controls must keep display metadata separate from submitted domain value semantics.

examples.request: Use Ada initials with verified presence, a compact corporate badge and selected reviewer emphasis.

controlProfiles.title: Display and action controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for non-data or action-like field controls.

editableTargets.description: Display/action metadata paths such as label, icon, action id, loading state and presentation mode.

validators.description: Display/action controls must not silently mutate submitted domain data unless an explicit action contract exists.

examples.request: Configure a button field to trigger the refresh action.

controlProfiles.title: Field shell controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for wrapper/shell controls that host another field contract.

editableTargets.description: Shell metadata paths such as label, hint, error projection, layout and child control reference.

validators.description: Field shell controls must delegate child semantics to the child control profile instead of redefining them.

examples.request: Set shell label and delegate rendering to inline select.

authoringManifestProfiles.title: Date controls
authoringManifestProfiles.description: Profile for single date, datetime, month, week, year and time picker controls.

editableTargets.description: Date/time metadata paths such as min, max, timezone, locale and format.

operations.title: Configure date or time field metadata

validators.description: Temporal min and max values must be valid and ordered for the target control granularity.
Timezone configuration must use a valid named timezone when the control is timezone-sensitive.

examples.request: Limit the date field to the current year in Sao Paulo timezone.
