runtimeInputs.name: fieldMetadata
runtimeInputs.description: Canonical field metadata consumed by dynamic field loaders.

runtimeInputs.name: controlType
runtimeInputs.description: Control type resolved through ComponentRegistryService.

runtimeInputs.name: componentRegistry
runtimeInputs.description: Runtime registry for package-owned and host custom fields.

runtimeInputs.name: componentMetadataRegistry
runtimeInputs.description: Editorial discovery registry for field tooling.

editableTargets.description: A canonical FieldControlType token.
Alias resolved through core control-type normalization.
Package-owned editorial descriptor in src/lib/editorial/**.
Selector-to-controlType mapping used by config-first flows.
FieldMetadata capability path governed by @praxisui/core.
Runtime ComponentRegistryService coverage for a control type.
Metadata-editor and downstream tooling coverage for a control type.

handlerContract.description: Registers a package-owned control type in runtime and metadata registries using stable controlType and selector identities.
Adds a deterministic control alias that normalizes to one registered canonical controlType.
Removes one alias by normalized alias identity after validating replacement coverage for downstream configs.
Maps a selector to a deterministic controlType through FieldSelectorRegistry without using host-only selector conventions.
Validates editor/tooling discovery for one controlType separately from runtime rendering support.
Validates runtime registry and value-accessor coverage for one controlType without implying editor coverage.

validators.description: Package-owned control types must be unique and stable.
ComponentRegistryService must resolve the runtime component for the target controlType.
Control metadata must align with FieldMetadata semantics from @praxisui/core.
Aliases must normalize to a single canonical controlType.
Alias removal requires an existing alias target.
Alias removal must provide migration or replacement when downstream configs may still use it.
Destructive alias removal requires explicit confirmation.
Editorial descriptor updates require an existing package-owned descriptor.
Package-owned editorial changes must originate in src/lib/editorial/**, not host overrides.
Dynamic-form, metadata-editor and downstream tooling must discover the control metadata.
Metadata mappings must align with FIELD_METADATA_CAPABILITIES and control-family capabilities.
Runtime support and editor/tooling coverage must not diverge silently.
Coverage validation operations must include concrete evidence paths or spec names.
Selector mappings must resolve to one controlType through FieldSelectorRegistry and must not shadow package defaults implicitly.

roundTripRequirements: Runtime support, editorial descriptor, ComponentDocMeta and playground/catalog projection must remain aligned for package-owned fields.
Aliases must resolve through the canonical core normalization path and must not become host-only conventions.
Editor coverage and runtime coverage must be reported separately; runtime rendering alone is not sufficient evidence of editor/tooling support.

examples.request: Register a package-owned field control and make it runtime-resolvable.
Allow legacy alias my-control to resolve to myControl.
Remove obsolete alias old-control after migration.
Update friendly name and icon for a package-owned control.
Map pdx-my-control to myControl in the selector registry.
Publish a metadata capability path for option source mapping.
Prove that metadata editor and dynamic form can discover the control.
Prove runtime registry and value accessor coverage.
Mark a control supported because it renders, without editor metadata evidence.

controlProfiles.title: Text input controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for text-like controls, including inline and Material text inputs.

editableTargets.description: Text metadata paths such as placeholder, length limits, pattern, mask and autocomplete.

validators.description: Text constraints must preserve string field semantics and editor/runtime round-trip.

examples.request: Set placeholder and maximum length for a text input.

roundTripRequirements: Text constraints must round-trip through FieldMetadata and downstream tooling without becoming host-only placeholder state.

controlProfiles.title: Numeric controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for number, slider, range, rating and score controls.

editableTargets.description: Numeric metadata paths such as min, max, step, precision and display format.

validators.description: Numeric min, max, step and precision must be mutually valid for the target control.

examples.request: Set rating control to five points with half-step increments.

controlProfiles.title: Distance radius filter
controlProfiles.description: Profile for the inline radial distance filter, including units, semantic marks, presets, colors and governed draft confirmation.

editableTargets.description: Distance-radius metadata paths for value bounds, units, radial presentation, semantic marks, presets, adaptive sizing and overlay confirmation.

validators.description: Distance bounds, step, unit conversion, marks and presets must preserve ordered values in the canonical base unit.
Radial colors, opacity and adaptive overlay bounds must remain legible and theme-safe.

examples.request: Configure a kilometre distance range with semantic marks, presets and explicit Apply and Cancel actions.

roundTripRequirements: Distance values remain stored in distanceBaseUnit while the selected display unit remains metadata-driven.
Accent and semantic distance gradient stops round-trip independently through editor and runtime.
Explicit overlay mode keeps draft changes local until Apply and restores the baseline on Cancel.

controlProfiles.title: Currency controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for currency and price-range controls.

editableTargets.description: Currency metadata paths such as currency code, locale, precision and range mode.

validators.description: Currency controls require a valid ISO currency code and locale-aware formatting semantics.
Currency range bounds must be ordered and compatible with precision.

examples.request: Configure the currency field for Brazilian Real with two decimals.

controlProfiles.title: Select controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for select, autocomplete, async select, chips, status, sentiment and button-toggle controls.

editableTargets.description: Option source, local options, display/value fields, search and multi-select metadata paths.

validators.description: Option controls require canonical optionSource/options semantics, including cascade dependency mappings when present.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Configure select to store ids and display labels.

controlProfiles.title: Entity lookup controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for entity lookup controls that bind to remote resources.

editableTargets.description: Entity lookup metadata paths such as resourcePath, value/display fields and governed dialog search behavior.

validators.description: Entity lookup controls require canonical resource binding and stable value/display identity fields.
Option controls require canonical optionSource/options semantics, including cascade dependency mappings when present.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Bind the entity lookup to users, show the name while storing the id, use the inline trigger to change the selection, and provide governed advanced search.

controlProfiles.title: Tree select controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for hierarchical tree select controls.

editableTargets.description: Tree option metadata paths such as node id, parent id, children path, lazy loading and multi-selection.

validators.description: Tree controls require stable node identity and valid parent/children references.
Tree option sources must expose hierarchical data compatible with the configured node fields.

examples.request: Configure tree select with id, parentId and children fields.

controlProfiles.title: List and transfer controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for selection-list and transfer-list controls.

editableTargets.description: List option metadata paths such as options, selection mode, value field and ordering.

validators.description: List selection metadata must preserve stable option identity and selected value shape.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Configure transfer list to store ids and display labels with a maximum of three selected items.

controlProfiles.title: Date controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for single date, datetime, month, week, year and time picker controls.

editableTargets.description: Date/time metadata paths such as min, max, timezone, locale and format.

operations.title: Configure date or time field metadata

validators.description: Temporal min and max values must be valid and ordered for the target control granularity.
Timezone configuration must use a valid named timezone when the control is timezone-sensitive.

examples.request: Limit the date field to the current year in Sao Paulo timezone.

controlProfiles.title: Date range controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for date range, month range, year range, period and relative-period controls.

editableTargets.description: Date range metadata paths such as start/end field mapping, min/max and presets.

validators.description: Date range controls require distinct start/end field semantics and ordered submitted values.
Temporal min and max values must be valid and ordered for the target control granularity.

examples.request: Use createdFrom and createdTo as the date range field names.

controlProfiles.title: Time range controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for time range controls.

editableTargets.description: Time range metadata paths such as start/end fields, step minutes and timezone.

validators.description: Time range controls require distinct start/end field semantics and valid interval steps.
Timezone configuration must use a valid named timezone when the control is timezone-sensitive.

examples.request: Configure a time range with fifteen minute increments.

controlProfiles.title: Toggle controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for boolean toggle controls.

editableTargets.description: Boolean metadata paths such as true label, false label and default value.

validators.description: Toggle controls must preserve boolean value semantics and not serialize labels as submitted values.

examples.request: Set yes/no labels for a toggle without changing boolean submission.

controlProfiles.title: Color controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for color input, precision picker and inline semantic color controls.

editableTargets.description: Color metadata paths such as format, structured fallback palettes and a versioned governed palette reference.

validators.description: Color values and local palette entries must be valid CSS color expressions.
A governed palette reference requires a published palette key and must honor a pinned version or ETag when supplied.

examples.request: Use the published corporate status palette version 3 for state colors.

controlProfiles.title: Regional document controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for Brazilian CPF/CNPJ document input controls.

editableTargets.description: Canonical Brazilian document metadata paths for full inputs and explicitly semantic partial-search filters.

validators.description: Regional document controls must preserve canonical document type, version, display mask and optional full-document validation semantics.

examples.request: Accept CPF or CNPJ and validate the complete document.

controlProfiles.title: File upload controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for file upload controls that bind field metadata to accepted file types, limits and storage semantics.

editableTargets.description: File upload metadata paths such as accepted types, maximum file size, multiplicity and upload endpoint binding.

validators.description: File upload controls require explicit file type, size and multiplicity constraints before storage binding.
Upload endpoint metadata must map to the canonical host/backend upload contract instead of an ad hoc URL.

examples.request: Allow up to three PDF files with a five megabyte limit.

controlProfiles.title: Collection controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for repeatable collection controls that manage array-shaped field values.

editableTargets.description: Collection metadata paths such as item schema, minimum and maximum items, ordering and add/remove behavior.

validators.description: Collection controls require array-compatible item schema and stable item identity semantics.

examples.request: Configure a repeatable address collection with at least one item.

controlProfiles.title: Avatar controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for avatar controls that render image, initials, fallback identity metadata or governed avatar groups.

editableTargets.description: Avatar metadata paths such as image source, initials, fallback icon, size, tone, status, badge, group stack and accessible text.

validators.description: Avatar controls must keep display metadata separate from submitted domain value semantics.

examples.request: Use Ada initials with verified presence, a compact corporate badge and selected reviewer emphasis.

controlProfiles.title: Display and action controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for non-data or action-like field controls.

editableTargets.description: Display/action metadata paths such as label, icon, action id, loading state and presentation mode.

validators.description: Display/action controls must not silently mutate submitted domain data unless an explicit action contract exists.

examples.request: Configure a button field to trigger the refresh action.

controlProfiles.title: Field shell controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for wrapper/shell controls that host another field contract.

editableTargets.description: Shell metadata paths such as label, hint, error projection, layout and child control reference.

validators.description: Field shell controls must delegate child semantics to the child control profile instead of redefining them.

examples.request: Set shell label and delegate rendering to inline select.

authoringManifestProfiles.title: Text input controls
authoringManifestProfiles.description: Profile for text-like controls, including inline and Material text inputs.

editableTargets.description: Text metadata paths such as placeholder, length limits, pattern, mask and autocomplete.

validators.description: Text constraints must preserve string field semantics and editor/runtime round-trip.

examples.request: Set placeholder and maximum length for a text input.

roundTripRequirements: Text constraints must round-trip through FieldMetadata and downstream tooling without becoming host-only placeholder state.

handlerContract.description: Registers a package-owned control type in runtime and metadata registries using stable controlType and selector identities.
Adds a deterministic control alias that normalizes to one registered canonical controlType.
Removes one alias by normalized alias identity after validating replacement coverage for downstream configs.
Maps a selector to a deterministic controlType through FieldSelectorRegistry without using host-only selector conventions.
Validates editor/tooling discovery for one controlType separately from runtime rendering support.
Validates runtime registry and value-accessor coverage for one controlType without implying editor coverage.

validators.description: Package-owned control types must be unique and stable.
ComponentRegistryService must resolve the runtime component for the target controlType.
Control metadata must align with FieldMetadata semantics from @praxisui/core.
Aliases must normalize to a single canonical controlType.
Alias removal requires an existing alias target.
Alias removal must provide migration or replacement when downstream configs may still use it.
Destructive alias removal requires explicit confirmation.
Editorial descriptor updates require an existing package-owned descriptor.
Package-owned editorial changes must originate in src/lib/editorial/**, not host overrides.
Dynamic-form, metadata-editor and downstream tooling must discover the control metadata.
Metadata mappings must align with FIELD_METADATA_CAPABILITIES and control-family capabilities.
Runtime support and editor/tooling coverage must not diverge silently.
Coverage validation operations must include concrete evidence paths or spec names.
Selector mappings must resolve to one controlType through FieldSelectorRegistry and must not shadow package defaults implicitly.

roundTripRequirements: Runtime support, editorial descriptor, ComponentDocMeta and playground/catalog projection must remain aligned for package-owned fields.
Aliases must resolve through the canonical core normalization path and must not become host-only conventions.
Editor coverage and runtime coverage must be reported separately; runtime rendering alone is not sufficient evidence of editor/tooling support.

Prove runtime registry and value accessor coverage.
Mark a control supported because it renders, without editor metadata evidence.

controlProfiles.title: Text input controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for text-like controls, including inline and Material text inputs.

editableTargets.description: Text metadata paths such as placeholder, length limits, pattern, mask and autocomplete.

validators.description: Text constraints must preserve string field semantics and editor/runtime round-trip.

examples.request: Set placeholder and maximum length for a text input.

roundTripRequirements: Text constraints must round-trip through FieldMetadata and downstream tooling without becoming host-only placeholder state.

controlProfiles.title: Numeric controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for number, slider, range, rating and score controls.

editableTargets.description: Numeric metadata paths such as min, max, step, precision and display format.

validators.description: Numeric min, max, step and precision must be mutually valid for the target control.

examples.request: Set rating control to five points with half-step increments.

controlProfiles.title: Distance radius filter
controlProfiles.description: Profile for the inline radial distance filter, including units, semantic marks, presets, colors and governed draft confirmation.

editableTargets.description: Distance-radius metadata paths for value bounds, units, radial presentation, semantic marks, presets, adaptive sizing and overlay confirmation.

validators.description: Distance bounds, step, unit conversion, marks and presets must preserve ordered values in the canonical base unit.
Radial colors, opacity and adaptive overlay bounds must remain legible and theme-safe.

examples.request: Configure a kilometre distance range with semantic marks, presets and explicit Apply and Cancel actions.

roundTripRequirements: Distance values remain stored in distanceBaseUnit while the selected display unit remains metadata-driven.
Accent and semantic distance gradient stops round-trip independently through editor and runtime.
Explicit overlay mode keeps draft changes local until Apply and restores the baseline on Cancel.

controlProfiles.title: Currency controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for currency and price-range controls.

editableTargets.description: Currency metadata paths such as currency code, locale, precision and range mode.

validators.description: Currency controls require a valid ISO currency code and locale-aware formatting semantics.
Currency range bounds must be ordered and compatible with precision.

examples.request: Configure the currency field for Brazilian Real with two decimals.

controlProfiles.title: Select controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for select, autocomplete, async select, chips, status, sentiment and button-toggle controls.

editableTargets.description: Option source, local options, display/value fields, search and multi-select metadata paths.

validators.description: Option controls require canonical optionSource/options semantics, including cascade dependency mappings when present.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Configure select to store ids and display labels.

controlProfiles.title: Entity lookup controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for entity lookup controls that bind to remote resources.

editableTargets.description: Entity lookup metadata paths such as resourcePath, value/display fields and governed dialog search behavior.

validators.description: Entity lookup controls require canonical resource binding and stable value/display identity fields.
Option controls require canonical optionSource/options semantics, including cascade dependency mappings when present.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Bind the entity lookup to users, show the name while storing the id, use the inline trigger to change the selection, and provide governed advanced search.

controlProfiles.title: Tree select controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for hierarchical tree select controls.

editableTargets.description: Tree option metadata paths such as node id, parent id, children path, lazy loading and multi-selection.

validators.description: Tree controls require stable node identity and valid parent/children references.
Tree option sources must expose hierarchical data compatible with the configured node fields.

examples.request: Configure tree select with id, parentId and children fields.

controlProfiles.title: List and transfer controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for selection-list and transfer-list controls.

editableTargets.description: List option metadata paths such as options, selection mode, value field and ordering.

validators.description: List selection metadata must preserve stable option identity and selected value shape.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Configure transfer list to store ids and display labels with a maximum of three selected items.

controlProfiles.title: Date controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for single date, datetime, month, week, year and time picker controls.

editableTargets.description: Date/time metadata paths such as min, max, timezone, locale and format.

operations.title: Configure date or time field metadata

validators.description: Temporal min and max values must be valid and ordered for the target control granularity.
Timezone configuration must use a valid named timezone when the control is timezone-sensitive.

examples.request: Limit the date field to the current year in Sao Paulo timezone.

controlProfiles.title: Date range controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for date range, month range, year range, period and relative-period controls.

editableTargets.description: Date range metadata paths such as start/end field mapping, min/max and presets.

validators.description: Date range controls require distinct start/end field semantics and ordered submitted values.
Temporal min and max values must be valid and ordered for the target control granularity.

examples.request: Use createdFrom and createdTo as the date range field names.

controlProfiles.title: Time range controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for time range controls.

editableTargets.description: Time range metadata paths such as start/end fields, step minutes and timezone.

validators.description: Time range controls require distinct start/end field semantics and valid interval steps.
Timezone configuration must use a valid named timezone when the control is timezone-sensitive.

examples.request: Configure a time range with fifteen minute increments.

controlProfiles.title: Toggle controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for boolean toggle controls.

editableTargets.description: Boolean metadata paths such as true label, false label and default value.

validators.description: Toggle controls must preserve boolean value semantics and not serialize labels as submitted values.

examples.request: Set yes/no labels for a toggle without changing boolean submission.

controlProfiles.title: Color controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for color input, precision picker and inline semantic color controls.

editableTargets.description: Color metadata paths such as format, structured fallback palettes and a versioned governed palette reference.

validators.description: Color values and local palette entries must be valid CSS color expressions.
A governed palette reference requires a published palette key and must honor a pinned version or ETag when supplied.

examples.request: Use the published corporate status palette version 3 for state colors.

controlProfiles.title: Regional document controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for Brazilian CPF/CNPJ document input controls.

editableTargets.description: Canonical Brazilian document metadata paths for full inputs and explicitly semantic partial-search filters.

validators.description: Regional document controls must preserve canonical document type, version, display mask and optional full-document validation semantics.

examples.request: Accept CPF or CNPJ and validate the complete document.

controlProfiles.title: File upload controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for file upload controls that bind field metadata to accepted file types, limits and storage semantics.

editableTargets.description: File upload metadata paths such as accepted types, maximum file size, multiplicity and upload endpoint binding.

validators.description: File upload controls require explicit file type, size and multiplicity constraints before storage binding.
Upload endpoint metadata must map to the canonical host/backend upload contract instead of an ad hoc URL.

examples.request: Allow up to three PDF files with a five megabyte limit.

controlProfiles.title: Collection controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for repeatable collection controls that manage array-shaped field values.

editableTargets.description: Collection metadata paths such as item schema, minimum and maximum items, ordering and add/remove behavior.

validators.description: Collection controls require array-compatible item schema and stable item identity semantics.

examples.request: Configure a repeatable address collection with at least one item.

controlProfiles.title: Avatar controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for avatar controls that render image, initials, fallback identity metadata or governed avatar groups.

editableTargets.description: Avatar metadata paths such as image source, initials, fallback icon, size, tone, status, badge, group stack and accessible text.

validators.description: Avatar controls must keep display metadata separate from submitted domain value semantics.

examples.request: Use Ada initials with verified presence, a compact corporate badge and selected reviewer emphasis.

controlProfiles.title: Display and action controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for non-data or action-like field controls.

editableTargets.description: Display/action metadata paths such as label, icon, action id, loading state and presentation mode.

validators.description: Display/action controls must not silently mutate submitted domain data unless an explicit action contract exists.

examples.request: Configure a button field to trigger the refresh action.

controlProfiles.title: Field shell controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for wrapper/shell controls that host another field contract.

editableTargets.description: Shell metadata paths such as label, hint, error projection, layout and child control reference.

validators.description: Field shell controls must delegate child semantics to the child control profile instead of redefining them.

examples.request: Set shell label and delegate rendering to inline select.

authoringManifestProfiles.title: Date controls
authoringManifestProfiles.description: Profile for single date, datetime, month, week, year and time picker controls.

editableTargets.description: Date/time metadata paths such as min, max, timezone, locale and format.

operations.title: Configure date or time field metadata

validators.description: Temporal min and max values must be valid and ordered for the target control granularity.
Timezone configuration must use a valid named timezone when the control is timezone-sensitive.

examples.request: Limit the date field to the current year in Sao Paulo timezone.

runtimeInputs.name: fieldMetadata
runtimeInputs.description: Canonical field metadata consumed by dynamic field loaders.

runtimeInputs.name: controlType
runtimeInputs.description: Control type resolved through ComponentRegistryService.

runtimeInputs.name: componentRegistry
runtimeInputs.description: Runtime registry for package-owned and host custom fields.

runtimeInputs.name: componentMetadataRegistry
runtimeInputs.description: Editorial discovery registry for field tooling.

editableTargets.description: A canonical FieldControlType token.
Alias resolved through core control-type normalization.
Package-owned editorial descriptor in src/lib/editorial/**.
Selector-to-controlType mapping used by config-first flows.
FieldMetadata capability path governed by @praxisui/core.
Runtime ComponentRegistryService coverage for a control type.
Metadata-editor and downstream tooling coverage for a control type.

handlerContract.description: Registers a package-owned control type in runtime and metadata registries using stable controlType and selector identities.
Adds a deterministic control alias that normalizes to one registered canonical controlType.
Removes one alias by normalized alias identity after validating replacement coverage for downstream configs.
Maps a selector to a deterministic controlType through FieldSelectorRegistry without using host-only selector conventions.
Validates editor/tooling discovery for one controlType separately from runtime rendering support.
Validates runtime registry and value-accessor coverage for one controlType without implying editor coverage.

validators.description: Package-owned control types must be unique and stable.
ComponentRegistryService must resolve the runtime component for the target controlType.
Control metadata must align with FieldMetadata semantics from @praxisui/core.
Aliases must normalize to a single canonical controlType.
Alias removal requires an existing alias target.
Alias removal must provide migration or replacement when downstream configs may still use it.
Destructive alias removal requires explicit confirmation.
Editorial descriptor updates require an existing package-owned descriptor.
Package-owned editorial changes must originate in src/lib/editorial/**, not host overrides.
Dynamic-form, metadata-editor and downstream tooling must discover the control metadata.
Metadata mappings must align with FIELD_METADATA_CAPABILITIES and control-family capabilities.
Runtime support and editor/tooling coverage must not diverge silently.
Coverage validation operations must include concrete evidence paths or spec names.
Selector mappings must resolve to one controlType through FieldSelectorRegistry and must not shadow package defaults implicitly.

roundTripRequirements: Runtime support, editorial descriptor, ComponentDocMeta and playground/catalog projection must remain aligned for package-owned fields.
Aliases must resolve through the canonical core normalization path and must not become host-only conventions.
Editor coverage and runtime coverage must be reported separately; runtime rendering alone is not sufficient evidence of editor/tooling support.

examples.request: Register a package-owned field control and make it runtime-resolvable.
Allow legacy alias my-control to resolve to myControl.
Remove obsolete alias old-control after migration.
Update friendly name and icon for a package-owned control.
Map pdx-my-control to myControl in the selector registry.
Publish a metadata capability path for option source mapping.
Prove that metadata editor and dynamic form can discover the control.
Prove runtime registry and value accessor coverage.
Mark a control supported because it renders, without editor metadata evidence.

controlProfiles.title: Text input controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for text-like controls, including inline and Material text inputs.

editableTargets.description: Text metadata paths such as placeholder, length limits, pattern, mask and autocomplete.

validators.description: Text constraints must preserve string field semantics and editor/runtime round-trip.

examples.request: Set placeholder and maximum length for a text input.

roundTripRequirements: Text constraints must round-trip through FieldMetadata and downstream tooling without becoming host-only placeholder state.

controlProfiles.title: Numeric controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for number, slider, range, rating and score controls.

editableTargets.description: Numeric metadata paths such as min, max, step, precision and display format.

validators.description: Numeric min, max, step and precision must be mutually valid for the target control.

examples.request: Set rating control to five points with half-step increments.

controlProfiles.title: Distance radius filter
controlProfiles.description: Profile for the inline radial distance filter, including units, semantic marks, presets, colors and governed draft confirmation.

editableTargets.description: Distance-radius metadata paths for value bounds, units, radial presentation, semantic marks, presets, adaptive sizing and overlay confirmation.

validators.description: Distance bounds, step, unit conversion, marks and presets must preserve ordered values in the canonical base unit.
Radial colors, opacity and adaptive overlay bounds must remain legible and theme-safe.

examples.request: Configure a kilometre distance range with semantic marks, presets and explicit Apply and Cancel actions.

roundTripRequirements: Distance values remain stored in distanceBaseUnit while the selected display unit remains metadata-driven.
Accent and semantic distance gradient stops round-trip independently through editor and runtime.
Explicit overlay mode keeps draft changes local until Apply and restores the baseline on Cancel.

controlProfiles.title: Currency controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for currency and price-range controls.

editableTargets.description: Currency metadata paths such as currency code, locale, precision and range mode.

validators.description: Currency controls require a valid ISO currency code and locale-aware formatting semantics.
Currency range bounds must be ordered and compatible with precision.

examples.request: Configure the currency field for Brazilian Real with two decimals.

controlProfiles.title: Select controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for select, autocomplete, async select, chips, status, sentiment and button-toggle controls.

editableTargets.description: Option source, local options, display/value fields, search and multi-select metadata paths.

validators.description: Option controls require canonical optionSource/options semantics, including cascade dependency mappings when present.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Configure select to store ids and display labels.

controlProfiles.title: Entity lookup controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for entity lookup controls that bind to remote resources.

editableTargets.description: Entity lookup metadata paths such as resourcePath, value/display fields and governed dialog search behavior.

validators.description: Entity lookup controls require canonical resource binding and stable value/display identity fields.
Option controls require canonical optionSource/options semantics, including cascade dependency mappings when present.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Bind the entity lookup to users, show the name while storing the id, use the inline trigger to change the selection, and provide governed advanced search.

controlProfiles.title: Tree select controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for hierarchical tree select controls.

editableTargets.description: Tree option metadata paths such as node id, parent id, children path, lazy loading and multi-selection.

validators.description: Tree controls require stable node identity and valid parent/children references.
Tree option sources must expose hierarchical data compatible with the configured node fields.

examples.request: Configure tree select with id, parentId and children fields.

controlProfiles.title: List and transfer controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for selection-list and transfer-list controls.

editableTargets.description: List option metadata paths such as options, selection mode, value field and ordering.

validators.description: List selection metadata must preserve stable option identity and selected value shape.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Configure transfer list to store ids and display labels with a maximum of three selected items.

controlProfiles.title: Date controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for single date, datetime, month, week, year and time picker controls.

editableTargets.description: Date/time metadata paths such as min, max, timezone, locale and format.

operations.title: Configure date or time field metadata

validators.description: Temporal min and max values must be valid and ordered for the target control granularity.
Timezone configuration must use a valid named timezone when the control is timezone-sensitive.

examples.request: Limit the date field to the current year in Sao Paulo timezone.

controlProfiles.title: Date range controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for date range, month range, year range, period and relative-period controls.

editableTargets.description: Date range metadata paths such as start/end field mapping, min/max and presets.

validators.description: Date range controls require distinct start/end field semantics and ordered submitted values.
Temporal min and max values must be valid and ordered for the target control granularity.

examples.request: Use createdFrom and createdTo as the date range field names.

controlProfiles.title: Time range controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for time range controls.

editableTargets.description: Time range metadata paths such as start/end fields, step minutes and timezone.

validators.description: Time range controls require distinct start/end field semantics and valid interval steps.
Timezone configuration must use a valid named timezone when the control is timezone-sensitive.

examples.request: Configure a time range with fifteen minute increments.

controlProfiles.title: Toggle controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for boolean toggle controls.

editableTargets.description: Boolean metadata paths such as true label, false label and default value.

validators.description: Toggle controls must preserve boolean value semantics and not serialize labels as submitted values.

examples.request: Set yes/no labels for a toggle without changing boolean submission.

controlProfiles.title: Color controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for color input, precision picker and inline semantic color controls.

editableTargets.description: Color metadata paths such as format, structured fallback palettes and a versioned governed palette reference.

validators.description: Color values and local palette entries must be valid CSS color expressions.
A governed palette reference requires a published palette key and must honor a pinned version or ETag when supplied.

examples.request: Use the published corporate status palette version 3 for state colors.

controlProfiles.title: Regional document controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for Brazilian CPF/CNPJ document input controls.

editableTargets.description: Canonical Brazilian document metadata paths for full inputs and explicitly semantic partial-search filters.

validators.description: Regional document controls must preserve canonical document type, version, display mask and optional full-document validation semantics.

examples.request: Accept CPF or CNPJ and validate the complete document.

controlProfiles.title: File upload controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for file upload controls that bind field metadata to accepted file types, limits and storage semantics.

editableTargets.description: File upload metadata paths such as accepted types, maximum file size, multiplicity and upload endpoint binding.

validators.description: File upload controls require explicit file type, size and multiplicity constraints before storage binding.
Upload endpoint metadata must map to the canonical host/backend upload contract instead of an ad hoc URL.

examples.request: Allow up to three PDF files with a five megabyte limit.

controlProfiles.title: Collection controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for repeatable collection controls that manage array-shaped field values.

editableTargets.description: Collection metadata paths such as item schema, minimum and maximum items, ordering and add/remove behavior.

validators.description: Collection controls require array-compatible item schema and stable item identity semantics.

examples.request: Configure a repeatable address collection with at least one item.

controlProfiles.title: Avatar controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for avatar controls that render image, initials, fallback identity metadata or governed avatar groups.

editableTargets.description: Avatar metadata paths such as image source, initials, fallback icon, size, tone, status, badge, group stack and accessible text.

validators.description: Avatar controls must keep display metadata separate from submitted domain value semantics.

examples.request: Use Ada initials with verified presence, a compact corporate badge and selected reviewer emphasis.

controlProfiles.title: Display and action controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for non-data or action-like field controls.

editableTargets.description: Display/action metadata paths such as label, icon, action id, loading state and presentation mode.

validators.description: Display/action controls must not silently mutate submitted domain data unless an explicit action contract exists.

examples.request: Configure a button field to trigger the refresh action.

controlProfiles.title: Field shell controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for wrapper/shell controls that host another field contract.

editableTargets.description: Shell metadata paths such as label, hint, error projection, layout and child control reference.

validators.description: Field shell controls must delegate child semantics to the child control profile instead of redefining them.

examples.request: Set shell label and delegate rendering to inline select.

authoringManifestProfiles.title: Date controls
authoringManifestProfiles.description: Profile for single date, datetime, month, week, year and time picker controls.

editableTargets.description: Date/time metadata paths such as min, max, timezone, locale and format.

operations.title: Configure date or time field metadata

validators.description: Temporal min and max values must be valid and ordered for the target control granularity.
Timezone configuration must use a valid named timezone when the control is timezone-sensitive.

examples.request: Limit the date field to the current year in Sao Paulo timezone.

editableTargets.description: Canonical `kind` field in PraxisXUiChartContract.
Metric-backed series definition in `metrics[]`, keyed by field.
Dimension role, metric axis and chart orientation semantics.
Source, dimensions, metrics and resource/field bindings.
Runtime @praxisui/core queryContext contract for filters, filterExpression, sort, limit, page and governance metadata.
Raw pointClick evidence plus a separate pointAction output for configured pointClick actions.
Cross-filter event mapping emitted as structured query-context filters.
Drilldown event mapping and governed target.
Single-point selection event enablement and mapping semantics; toggle and multi-select are intentionally not advertised.
Legend visibility through boolean or toggleable feature object.
Tooltip visibility through boolean or toggleable feature object.
Canonical scalar gauge scale at `chartDocument.gauge.scale`, with finite `min` and `max` bounds.

handlerContract.description: Adds a metric-backed series by semantic field, validating it against availableFields and chart kind compatibility before patching metrics[]. Scatter accepts at most two ordered metrics, mapped to X and Y in the dual-measure mode.
Configures dimensions and metric axes using semantic fields, preserving combo-only secondary axis constraints.

Binds a derived or praxis.stats source using governed resource, capability and field catalogs. For praxis.stats, availableResources[].id is discovery-only: validation requires the matching availableResources[].path and compilation persists that path. Gauge bindings preserve the canonical scalar limit; comparison requires one canonical operation, metrics[] and an eligible period field.
Configures pointClick through the pointAction output while keeping pointClick as raw point evidence.

Configures crossFilter as a structured event action emitted through the crossFilter output with safe query-context filters to a governed target. For praxis.stats rows, key is governed bucket identity and label is presentation evidence; mappings may use key when the target schema accepts that identity.
Configures drillDown through the dedicated drillDown output with governed route/widget targets and structured field mappings.

Configures selectionChange as single-point selection evidence whose event key is governed by the operation. Repeating the active point clears the selection and emits empty filters; selecting another point replaces it.

validators.description: Document must conform to PraxisXUiChartContract.
Chart kind must be supported by @praxisui/charts.
Chart kind, dimensions, metrics and axes must be compatible.
Pie, donut, funnel, pyramid and treemap charts require exactly one metric.
Combo charts require at least two metrics.
Gauge charts require one dimension, exactly one metric and, for praxis.stats, one group-by bucket selected with source.options.limit=1.
Gauge scale requires finite min and max values with max greater than min; runtime rejects values outside the declared scale without clamping.
Series field must exist in availableFields or schema context.
Metric fields must support the requested aggregation.
Metric/series identity must be stable and unique by field.
Series removal target must exist.
Removing a series requires explicit confirmation.
A chart cannot be left without required metrics.
Axis/dimension fields must exist in availableFields or schema context.
Secondary axis is supported only for combo charts.
Cartesian charts require at least one dimension.
Remote praxis.stats resource must equal a governed root-relative availableResources[].path beginning with exactly one slash; a discovery id is not an executable resource path.
Bound dimensions and metrics must exist in the capability-backed field context and satisfy its operation, aggregation and distribution-mode eligibility.
Remote datasource operation must be supported by the stats backend.
Comparison requires a time-series eligible period field, timezone, preset and mode grounded in the governed resource capabilities.
Comparison requires unique metrics[] aliases using only COUNT, DISTINCT_COUNT or SUM capabilities; singular metric payloads are not authorable.
queryContext must use the canonical @praxisui/core structure for filters, filterExpression, sort, limit, page and meta.
praxis.stats currently executes only flat queryContext.filters; governed filterExpression must be preserved for diagnostics and rejected until backend expression support is declared.
queryContext filter fields should exist in the schema/data context.
queryContext values must be serializable safe data.
Configured pointClick actions must be emitted through pointAction while pointClick remains raw point evidence.
Cross-filter output must be structured as query-context filters.
Event targets must resolve to exactly one availableTargets[].id and declare the authored event plus action; missing, duplicate or cross-event identities fail closed.
Event mapping source fields must exist in chart data context; praxis.stats reserves key for bucket identity and label for presentation.
Event action must be one of the supported structured action kinds.
Drilldown target must be a governed route or widget target.
Selection output must resolve selected point filters deterministically.
Legend and tooltip feature values must be boolean or toggleable feature objects.
PraxisChartConfigEditor must save/reopen the same canonical document that runtime consumes.

roundTripRequirements: The canonical saved shape is PraxisXUiChartContract, not raw ECharts options.
PraxisChartConfigEditor must preserve chart kind, source, dimensions, metrics, events, legend and tooltip across apply/save/reset/reopen.

Remote bindings persist availableResources[].path; availableResources[].id remains discovery identity, and transient resource/field/target catalogs and diagnostics are never persisted in widget inputs.
Comparison must preserve one canonical /stats/comparison request with metrics[] and a complete comparisonPeriod; it must not downgrade into independent group-by calls.
Scatter with one metric preserves dimension-X/metric-Y semantics; scatter with two metrics preserves the dimension as grouped bucket identity and ordered metrics as X/Y.
Gauge preserves one dimension, exactly one metric, finite gauge.scale bounds and, for praxis.stats, the canonical group-by request with source.options.limit=1.
Cross-filter, drilldown and selection authoring must persist structured event actions, not prompt examples or command strings.

[P1] Backend handler, resolver and validators now execute directly; end-to-end Page Builder parity remains open until assistant requests project the transient availableTargets[].events catalog through validationContext and expose its fail-closed diagnostics.

[P2] Transform-output semantics and target input-schema/port fields must be materialized and validated by Core; local transform.output inspection and backend-enriched inputFields are not substitutes for those canonical projections.
Enrichment of capability-backed availableFields with /schemas/filtered property metadata remains a later schema-flow gate.

praxis-crud.description: Tabela com operações de CRUD via metadados.

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.description: Metadados de configuração do CRUD (fonte remota via resource.path ou local via metadata.data).

inputs.name: metadata.interactionMode
inputs.description: Decisão canônica de interação. inspect-only exige dados locais e bloqueia ações, resource binding, surfaces e authoring no próprio runtime.

inputs.name: crudId
inputs.description: Identificador do CRUD (base para tabela/formulário e persistência).

inputs.name: componentInstanceId
inputs.description: Identificador opcional para múltiplas instâncias na mesma rota.

inputs.name: tableConfigPersistenceStrategy
inputs.description: Política da tabela interna. Use input-first para contratos governados autoritativos e volatile para previews que não devem ler nem gravar preferências locais.

inputs.name: context
inputs.description: Contexto opaco do host. A implementação atual o expõe como Input e o usa para seeds editoriais do authoring.

inputs.name: metadata.queryContext
inputs.description: Contexto semântico de consulta encaminhado para a tabela interna do CRUD. Preferir este contrato para novo authoring remoto.

inputs.name: metadata.resource.schemaPath
inputs.description: Template canonico opcional usado apenas para resolver /schemas/filtered quando resource.path precisa ser um alvo operacional concreto.

inputs.name: metadata.resource.title
inputs.description: Titulo documental do recurso usado pelo shell CRUD para derivar titulos contextuais de criacao, edicao e visualizacao quando a action nao informa label.

inputs.name: metadata.resource.formTitle
inputs.description: Titulo documental especifico para formularios do recurso, usado antes de metadata.resource.title no shell modal/drawer.

inputs.name: metadata.filterCriteria
inputs.description: Bridge declarativa de filtros encaminhada para a tabela interna. Para novo authoring, prefira metadata.queryContext.

inputs.name: metadata.form
inputs.description: ConfiguraÃ§Ã£o do formulÃ¡rio encaminhada para o PraxisDynamicForm aberto por aÃ§Ãµes modal/drawer; layout, fieldMetadata, actions e helpPresentation permanecem propriedade do Dynamic Form.

inputs.name: metadata.actions[].form
inputs.description: Contrato da ação para modal/drawer. submitLabel personaliza apenas a apresentação; schemaUrl, submitUrl e submitMethod continuam sujeitos à resolução canônica por resource.path e discovery.

inputs.name: enableCustomization
inputs.description: Habilita modo de customização do layout.

inputs.name: showResourceIdentityKey
inputs.description: Controla se modal e drawer exibem a chave da identidade canônica do registro. Use false quando a chave pública for opaca ou apenas técnica; o título legível permanece visível.

inputs.name: authoringCapability
inputs.description: Capability publica do contexto corporativo exigida para disponibilizar authoring governado no CRUD e na tabela interna.

outputs.name: afterOpen
outputs.description: Emitido após abrir diálogo.

outputs.name: afterClose
outputs.description: Emitido após fechar diálogo.

outputs.name: afterSave
outputs.description: Emitido ao salvar.

outputs.name: afterDelete
outputs.description: Emitido ao deletar.

outputs.name: reactiveDeterminationExecuted
outputs.description: Evidencia metadata-only encaminhada pelo formulario aberto, com contexto da acao CRUD.

outputs.name: reactiveDeterminationPendingChange
outputs.description: Estado agregado de estabilizacao do formulario aberto, sem valores sensiveis.

outputs.name: reactiveDeterminationStabilityChange
outputs.description: Conclusao agregada do formulario aberto, distinguindo settled-satisfied de settled-unsatisfied e preservando o contexto da acao.

outputs.name: rowClick
outputs.description: Encaminha o clique de linha da tabela interna para composição master-detail e seleção local.

outputs.name: rowAction
outputs.description: Encaminha a ação contextual da linha com row, action e resourceIdentity para composição governada.

outputs.name: selectionChange
outputs.description: Encaminha a mudança de seleção da tabela interna quando o CRUD é usado como widget composto.

outputs.name: resourceEvent
outputs.description: Encaminha o envelope canônico da tabela interna com kind, resourcePath, resourceId, payload e contexto para composição governada.

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Emitido em erros.

outputs.name: configureRequested
outputs.description: Emitido quando o CTA de configuração é acionado em modo de edição.

outputs.name: crudAuthoringDocumentApplied
outputs.description: Emitido quando o editor canônico do CRUD aplica um documento e publica o patch de inputs do widget para hosts como praxis-dynamic-page.

outputs.name: crudAuthoringDocumentSaved
outputs.description: Emitido quando o editor canônico do CRUD salva um documento e publica o patch de inputs do widget para hosts como praxis-dynamic-page.

ports.label: Row Click

ports.description: Seleção encaminhada pela tabela interna. Linhas selecionadas devem permanecer JSON-safe para composição e persistência em state.

ports.label: Resource Event
ports.description: Envelope canônico encaminhado pela tabela interna para interações de recurso governadas.

ports.description: Lifecycle externo emitido depois que o launcher materializa a abertura da ação CRUD.

ports.label: After Save
ports.description: Resultado semântico normalizado após save. O payload data deve permanecer JSON-safe para composição.

ports.label: After Delete
ports.description: Resultado semântico normalizado após delete e antes da atualização da tabela.

DOC: Widget purpose: CRUD shell that composes a table + optional form from metadata.
DOC: Host inputs: metadata (required) and crudId (required). componentInstanceId/context/enableCustomization are optional.
DOC: CrudMetadata requires component='praxis-crud' and table (TableConfig).
DOC: inner table renders with resource.path (remote) or metadata.data (local). If both are provided, resource.path takes precedence.

handlerContract.description: Binds CRUD to a canonical resource and validates it against api_metadata/resource capabilities before runtime use. Use CrudMetadata.resource.schemaPath when schema discovery must use a templated path while resource.path targets a concrete nested collection.
Resolves read-only domain vocabulary/governance context and stores only a lightweight reference/probe under queryContext.meta.domainCatalog.
Configures CRUD-owned list orchestration while routing table semantics to the praxis-table manifest.
Configures create action binding and launcher inputs without editing the child FormConfig.
Configures edit action routing/form binding and ensures id parameter mapping is available to the launcher.
Configures view action binding and delegates readonly form behavior to the dynamic-form manifest.
Enables or disables delete behavior with capability checks and explicit confirmation for destructive changes.
Configures CRUD-owned route/modal/drawer defaults consumed by the launcher, default dialog-backed drawer runtime and optional host drawer adapter.
Aligns CRUD action visibility/disablement with resource capabilities without inventing a second permission source.
Records explicit delegation when requested edits belong to child manifests instead of CRUD orchestration.

validators.description: Resource must exist in api_metadata or resource discovery.
Resource path must be canonical and not a local alias.
Resource key must remain stable for surfaces/actions/capabilities.
CRUD id field must exist for edit/view/delete flows.
Resource capabilities must be resolvable before action enablement is authored.
Domain Catalog governance context must resolve for the resource key and requested probe before authoring uses it.
Domain Catalog is read-only semantic context; CRUD may reference a probe but must not persist copied catalog rules.
Authoring must respect Domain Catalog aiUsage.visibility before exposing field data, prompts or generated patches.
Shared domain governance must not be materialized into FormConfig rules unless a backend policy explicitly authorizes it.
Table semantics must be delegated to praxis-table.
Query context must be valid for the bound resource.
filterCriteria is a bridge; prefer queryContext for new remote authoring.
Authoring must not break stable crudContext references.
Target action must exist or be created through CRUD action orchestration.
route requires route; modal/drawer require formId unless resolved by governed overrides.
Schema URLs must be canonical for the bound resource/action.
Submit URL and method must be canonical and declared together.
Create surface requires resource create capability.
Edit surface requires resource edit capability.
View surface requires resource view capability.
FormConfig and FieldMetadata edits must delegate to dynamic-form/metadata-editor manifests.
Edit/view actions must map resource id into route/query/input as required.
Readonly form behavior belongs to the dynamic-form manifest.
Delete behavior requires a delete action target.
Delete behavior requires resource delete capability.
Destructive delete behavior requires explicit confirmation.
Delete permission cannot bypass resource capabilities or confirmation policy.
Open mode must be route, modal or drawer.
Modal sizing defaults must be valid DialogConfig values.

Drawer open mode uses the default dialog-backed drawer runtime with CRUD-owned chrome, responsive right-panel sizing, Escape/backdrop handling and semantic close/save results; a host drawer adapter is optional only for shell-specific presentation.
A drawer must preserve its configured viewport edge through open, remembered-size restoration, maximize and restore.
Back policy must be valid for route/modal/drawer behavior.
Authoring shell must preserve apply/save/reset semantics.
Action permissions must map to supported resource capabilities.
Delete permission enablement requires confirmation policy.
UI permissions must not shadow backend capability denial.
Delegated child manifest must be available.
Delegated operation must exist in the child manifest.
CRUD must not locally redefine FormConfig semantics.
CRUD must not locally redefine TableConfig semantics.
Delegation target must be resolvable by the child manifest.

roundTripRequirements: CrudMetadata is the canonical CRUD document shape.
CrudAuthoringDocument wraps CrudMetadata without introducing host-local aliases.
Resource path and resource key have separate semantics: path is operational, key is discovery/capability identity.
Domain Catalog context is referenced through resourceKey/release/probe and stays read-only; CRUD may attach queryContext.meta.domainCatalog but must not copy shared governance rules into FormConfig.
Open mode round-trip must preserve route, formId, form contract, params, initialValue and back policy.
FormConfig and FieldMetadata edits must delegate to dynamic-form or metadata-editor manifests.
TableConfig edits must delegate to praxis-table; CRUD owns only shell orchestration and list surface binding.
Delete behavior is destructive and requires explicit confirmation plus backend capability support.
Drawer position and edgeGap must round-trip without changing the configured edge during open, remembered-size restoration, maximize or restore.
crudContext must remain reference-stable across change detection cycles.

validators.description: Dialog or alertdialog must keep an accessible title or aria label.
ariaRole must be dialog or alertdialog.
Shell edits must target supported PraxisDialogConfig fields.
Size values must be finite numbers or safe CSS size strings.
Minimum sizes must not exceed maximum sizes.
Position values must be safe CSS size strings.
Conflicting position pairs should be explicit and intentional.
Backdrop and backdrop-click behavior must be explicit when edited.
Backdrop classes must be serializable safe class values.
Close behavior must explicitly describe ESC, backdrop and navigation semantics.
Disabling safe close affordances or enabling unsafe dismissal requires confirmation.
restoreFocus must stay enabled unless intentionally changed with confirmation.
alertdialog focus behavior must keep primary action or configured focus target reachable.
Preset type and variant must exist in PRAXIS_DIALOG_GLOBAL_PRESETS or be host-provided.
Preset merge order must remain type -> variant -> local config.
Child component/template must resolve through ComponentMetadataRegistry or dialog registries.
Child component config edits must be delegated to the child authoring manifest.
Child inputs/data persisted by authoring must be serializable safe values.
Delegated child operation must resolve a child component authoring manifest.
Delegated child operation must be declared by the child manifest.
Dialog shell operations must not rewrite child component semantics directly.
Service/tag mode must preserve shell config through open, close, afterClosed and host persistence.

roundTripRequirements: PraxisDialogConfig is the canonical shell config; child component config remains owned by the child manifest.
Preset application must preserve merge order: type preset, then variant, then local config.
Close policy edits must keep accessibility, focus trap, ESC/backdrop behavior and restoreFocus explicit.
Dialog host operations must resolve component/template ids through governed registries instead of ad hoc overlays.

Make an alertdialog with no title or aria label.
Let a destructive dialog close on accidental backdrop click with no confirmation.

Selector: praxis-dialog
Friendly Name: Praxis Dialog

  - close (unknown)
  - opened (void)
  - afterClosed (void)

praxis-dynamic-form.description: Formulario dinamico com layout por secoes/linhas/colunas e campos renderizados por metadados.

inputs.name: initialValue
inputs.description: Valores iniciais locais aplicados antes da interacao do usuario
inputs.label: Valor inicial

inputs.name: emptyState
inputs.description: Placeholder opt-in exibido em mode=view enquanto não houver resourceId nem snapshot local selecionado.
inputs.label: Estado sem contexto

inputs.name: editorialContext
inputs.description: Contexto compartilhado usado para resolver bindings do rich content hospedado no form
inputs.label: Contexto editorial

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Configuracao completa do formulario (layout, metadados, acoes, regras e headers de secao com `sectionHeader` para icone/avatar dinamico e `headerActions` para acoes contextuais).
inputs.label: Configuracao

inputs.name: actions
inputs.description: Overrides de apresentação da barra de ações fornecidos pelo host; preservam schema, método e endpoint canônicos.
inputs.label: Ações

inputs.name: schemaUrl
inputs.description: Schema canonico explicito publicado pelo backend (ex.: surfaces/capabilities)

inputs.name: readUrl
inputs.description: URL canonica de leitura publicada por surfaces VIEW/READ_PROJECTION

inputs.name: apiEndpointKey
inputs.description: Endpoint canonico usado para resolver schemaUrl, readUrl e submitUrl relativos em hosts destacados

inputs.name: apiUrlEntry
inputs.description: Entrada de API ja resolvida para hosts destacados que nao herdam o provider de API_URL da rota atual

inputs.name: submitUrl
inputs.description: URL canonica de submit publicada pelo backend para forms orientados a surface

inputs.name: submitMethod
inputs.description: Metodo HTTP canonico do submit quando a surface publica operacao explicita

inputs.name: submitIdempotencyKey
inputs.description: Chave estável da tentativa de comando, preservada em retries e enviada como Idempotency-Key

inputs.name: submitCorrelationId
inputs.description: Identificador de correlação do comando enviado como X-Correlation-Id para observabilidade ponta a ponta

inputs.name: submitResourceVersion
inputs.description: Versão persistida esperada enviada como If-Match quando a ação governada exige concorrência otimista

inputs.name: submitResourceVersionTargetResourceKey
inputs.description: Resource key canônico cujo ETag atual deve ser resolvido no submit quando a ação protege outro agregado

inputs.name: submitResourceVersionTargetIdField
inputs.description: Campo exato do request que carrega o identificador do recurso concorrente selecionado

inputs.name: responseSchemaUrl
inputs.description: Schema de resposta publicado pelo backend apenas para diagnostico e follow-up; nao compoe campos editaveis nem o payload do comando

inputs.name: enableCustomization
inputs.description: Habilita modo de customizacao do layout (canvas)

inputs.name: showAiAssistant
inputs.description: Mostra os gatilhos do copiloto semantico Praxis para esta instancia do formulario

inputs.name: formId
inputs.description: Chave para persistencia local da configuracao

inputs.name: componentInstanceId
inputs.description: Identificador estavel para instancias multiplas do formulario

inputs.name: configPersistenceStrategy
inputs.description: Define se a configuracao local persistida ou os inputs do host tem precedencia; input-first preserva inclusive o mode explicito contra preferencias persistidas.

inputs.name: layout
inputs.description: Layout opcional em vez do gerado

inputs.name: generatedLayoutPreset
inputs.description: Preset usado apenas ao criar a configuracao inicial a partir de metadata/schema.

inputs.name: layoutPolicy
inputs.description: Politica opt-in para materializar layout a partir do schema sem persistir sections geradas por padrao.

inputs.name: hooks
inputs.description: Declaracoes de hooks de ciclo de vida do formulario

inputs.name: removeEmptyContainersOnSave
inputs.description: Remove containers vazios ao salvar configuracao

inputs.name: notifyIfOutdated
inputs.description: Canal de notificacao para schema desatualizado

inputs.name: autoOpenSettingsOnOutdated
inputs.description: Abre editor automaticamente quando schema esta desatualizado

inputs.name: readonlyModeGlobal
inputs.description: Trava global para campos em modo somente-leitura

inputs.name: presentation
inputs.description: Projeção de contextSnapshot.presentation para hosts e Page Builder. Tamanhos em pixels; null remove ajustes explícitos. Não altera mode nem presentationModeGlobal.

inputs.name: presentationPreset
inputs.description: Preset visual nativo para modo apresentação: corporate-dossier, editorial-card, compact-presentation ou default.
inputs.label: Preset de Apresentação

inputs.name: presentationModeGlobal
inputs.description: Preferência de exibição, também editável em Geral: true apresenta em view, false força campos, null segue layoutPolicy. Persiste em bindings.presentationModeGlobal.

inputs.name: fieldIconPolicy
inputs.description: Controla se icones prefix/suffix de campos aparecem em controles tradicionais ou apenas em apresentacao.

outputs.name: formSubmit
outputs.description: Emite ao submeter o formulario
outputs.label: Submit

outputs.name: formCancel
outputs.description: Emite ao cancelar

outputs.name: formReset
outputs.description: Emite ao resetar

outputs.name: configChange
outputs.description: Emite quando a configuracao do formulario muda
outputs.label: Configuracao alterada

outputs.name: configPatchChange
outputs.description: Emite inputPatch parcial com config, resourcePath, mode, presentationModeGlobal e/ou presentation para hosts persistirem apenas as entradas autoradas presentes, incluindo conexao rapida, sem alterar o payload legado de configChange.
outputs.label: Patch persistivel de configuracao

outputs.name: formReady
outputs.description: Emite quando o formulario esta pronto
outputs.label: Form pronto

outputs.name: valueChange
outputs.description: Emite quando valores mudam
outputs.label: Valor alterado

outputs.name: payloadPreviewChange
outputs.description: Projeta o payload persistível atual sem hooks de submit nem HTTP
outputs.label: Prévia do payload

outputs.name: syncCompleted
outputs.description: Emite quando a sincronizacao com metadados do servidor completa

outputs.name: initializationError
outputs.description: Emite erro de inicializacao com contexto

outputs.name: enableCustomizationChange
outputs.description: Emite quando o modo de customizacao de layout muda
outputs.label: Customizacao (toggle)

outputs.name: customAction
outputs.description: Emite quando uma acao customizada e executada

outputs.name: actionConfirmation
outputs.description: Resultado de confirmacoes de acoes

outputs.name: schemaStatusChange
outputs.type: { outdated: boolean; serverHash?: string; lastVerifiedAt?: string; formId?: string }
outputs.description: Emite quando o status do schema muda

outputs.name: reactiveDeterminationExecuted
outputs.description: Emite evidência metadata-only sem valores sensíveis ao iniciar, executar, ignorar ou falhar uma determinação reativa backend.

outputs.name: reactiveDeterminationPendingChange
outputs.description: Emite o estado agregado de estabilizacao das determinacoes, sem valores do formulario ou da resposta.

actions.label: Enviar
actions.description: Emite evento ao submeter o formulario

actions.label: Cancelar
actions.description: Emite evento ao cancelar o formulario

actions.label: Limpar
actions.description: Emite evento ao resetar o formulario

source.description: Origem da acao

sectionId.description: ID da secao quando a acao veio do header de uma secao

ports.label: Resource ID
ports.description: Canonical record identity used to hydrate edit and view forms.

ports.label: Initial Value
ports.description: Local value seed applied before the user interacts with the form.

ports.label: Value Change
ports.description: Runtime form value event including the current payload and validity.

ports.label: Form Submit
ports.description: Submit lifecycle event emitted at before, after and error stages.

ports.label: Payload Preview Change
ports.description: Non-destructive projection of the current persistence payload without submit hooks or HTTP.

runtimeProfiles.description: Formulário local somente-leitura, sem persistência, endpoints, rich content, hooks, comandos ou controles remotos.

hints: Use fieldMetadata[].name as the canonical field id; avoid array indexes.
Local fields are real form controls. Create them in fieldMetadata[] with source:"local", usually transient:true and submitPolicy:"omit", then place them as kind:"field" layout items.
submitPolicy accepts only "omit", "include", or "includeWhenDirty". If legacy prompt text says "never", normalize it to "omit" before persisting.
Visual blocks are not fields. Store them only as kind:"richContent" layout items and never in fieldMetadata[].
Use sections[].rows[].columns[].items[] as the canonical mixed layout order. kind:"field" items reference fieldMetadata; kind:"richContent" items are visual blocks outside submit payload.
Keep sections[].rows[].columns[].fields[] only as a field projection/migration path; do not create visual blocks there.
For visualBlock formRules that change text, title, or message in a composed richContent document, use textNodeId, titleNodeId, or messageNodeId from the rule authoring context.

For field formRules that must calculate a FormControl value, use effect.properties.value with the closed envelope { expression: <JSON Logic> }, such as { expression: { yearsSince: [{ var: "birthDate" }] } }. Use the closed envelope { literal: <value> } for structured literal objects; do not add extra keys and do not generate TypeScript functions.

For conditional side effects, use formCommandRules with effects[].kind:"global-action" and a structured globalAction ref. The visual editor authors the primary effect and preserves secondary effects from advanced JSON. Do not put alert/modal/navigation commands inside formRules[].effect.properties.
LLM-created formRules must include metadata.origin:"llm" and metadata.reviewStatus:"pending"; never write generated formRulesState.
Domain guidance rules should usually target visualBlock when they only change advisory copy, compliance warnings, or operational instructions without changing submitted data.
For layout edits, prefer adding or merging sections/rows/columns instead of replacing arrays. Use _delete: true for removal.
Avoid non-serializable hooks or functions in patches; use plain strings or ask for manual edits.
When adding sections/rows/columns, provide a unique "id" for each new element.
For nested layout changes (column within a row within a section), explicitly define "target.sectionId", "target.rowId", "target.columnId" in user prompt for clarity.
DOC: Widget purpose: dynamic form driven by FormConfig (layout + fields).
DOC: Host inputs: config (optional, defaults to { sections: [] }) and resourcePath (optional). mode is optional (create/edit/view).
DOC: When config is provided, sections[] define layout; fieldMetadata[] defines fields referenced by sections.
DOC: If the form should be schema-driven, resourcePath + schemaSource are needed to fetch schema.
DOC: resourcePath must be the base resource path only (no /filter, /all, /{id}). CRUD endpoints are handled internally.

Use source=schema apenas quando o backend schema for a fonte canonica do agrupamento; use detailSummary para seleção de campos e densidade responsiva do resumo read-only compacto sem FormConfig.sections locais. Quando o resumo precisar vencer x-ui.width publicado para outras surfaces, use detailSummary.widthPrecedence=summary. Em groupedCommand, orphanFieldExpansion governa linhas lógicas com um unico campo; partialRowStrategy=fill-compatible projeta spans compatíveis depois de resolver visibilidade responsiva, CSS order e wrap, sem alterar x-ui.width ou persistir sections; contextFields identifica campos do request hidratados pela surface que permanecem no payload sem criar controles redundantes.

targetType.description: Projeções visuais sempre apontam para richContent layout items e não representam a decisão canônica.

condition.description: JsonLogic AST; quando true aplica properties, quando false aplica propertiesWhenFalse. Visual-safe subset: field comparisons with scalar or field operands plus and/or groups. Advanced operators are runtime JSON-only until focused visual round-trip support exists.

properties.description: Use apenas propriedades suportadas por RULE_PROPERTY_SCHEMA.visualBlock; não escreva document, HTML, handlers, dados de payload ou regra de negócio canônica.

origin.description: Origem obrigatória para regra sugerida por IA.

validators.description: O campo alvo deve existir em fieldMetadata.
Nomes de campos devem ser únicos em fieldMetadata.
IDs de seções devem ser únicos em sections[].
A seção alvo deve existir em sections[].
Campo definido em fieldMetadata mas ausente no layout.
Nome de campo local não pode colidir com campo schema-backed existente.
Operação restrita a campos locais (source:"local"). Campo schema-backed não pode ser removido ou ter submitPolicy alterada.
IDs de regras devem ser únicos em formRules[].
A regra alvo deve existir em formRules[].
Todos os targets da regra devem referenciar campos, seções, ações ou blocos visuais existentes.

Valores calculados devem usar envelope explícito e fechado, exatamente { expression: <JsonLogic> } ou exatamente { literal: <valor> }; objetos literais sem envelope ou envelopes com chaves extras são ambíguos.
A expressão JsonLogic deve ser um AST válido (suporte canônico à spec JsonLogic).
A seção/linha/coluna de destino devem existir antes de mover o campo.
Operações de layout não devem usar índice de array como identidade canônica; use IDs estáveis.
A linha alvo deve existir na seção especificada.
O id da nova linha deve ser único dentro da seção alvo.
O id da nova coluna deve ser único dentro da linha alvo.
O tipo de controle deve ser compatível com o tipo de dado do campo.
A fonte de opções deve ser válida para o tipo de controle especificado.
Edição não deve corromper propriedades críticas para o round-trip do editor. Aplicado após operações que afetam submitPolicy ou source de campos locais.
O bloco visual alvo deve existir como item kind:"richContent" em sections[].rows[].columns[].items[].
IDs de blocos visuais devem ser unicos entre os itens de layout do formulario.
O document do bloco visual deve seguir o contrato RichContentDocument canonico.

roundTripRequirements: strip-undefined
normalize-json-logic
stable-field-order
preserve-column-layout-items
preserve-local-field-source
preserve-section-row-column-ids
