componentCapabilityNotes: page segue o modelo canonico WidgetPageDefinition (widgets, composition.links, context e state opcional); composition.links pode despachar actions globais via to.kind = global-action e receber continuations exatas via from.kind = global-action.
Conteudo editorial rico deve ser modelado como widget praxis-rich-content com definition.inputs.document: RichContentDocument, nao como DSL local do page-builder.

Quando definition.id = praxis-rich-content em uma pagina dinamica, definition.inputs.document continua sendo o contrato persistido; hostCapabilities e mediado em runtime pelo host praxis-dynamic-page e nao deve ser serializado no JSON da pagina.

Edicao visual de inputs de widget deve usar ComponentDocMeta.configEditor ou ComponentDocMeta.authoringManifestRef publicado pela lib dona do componente; nao criar editor local no page-builder para semantica de outro pacote.
Canvas e o modelo espacial canonico da pagina quando houver posicionamento explicito.
Taxonomia editorial: condition usa Json Logic canonico; transform usa pipeline declarativo; policy cobre apenas comportamento operacional.
Para criacao agentic de paginas, o preview pode trazer uiCompositionPlan como plano intermediario validavel; o page-builder compila esse plano para WidgetPageDefinition antes de aplicar.

UiCompositionPlan usa widgets[].componentId e bindings declarativos. UiCompositionPlanTemplateReference pode piná-lo por registryKey + configSha256, mas precisa ser resolvido pelo backend governado antes da compilação. O JSON persistido continua sendo page.widgets[].definition.id e page.composition.links.

Nested component ports usam endpoint component-port com nestedPath. O owner em ref.widget ou bindings[].*.widget continua sendo o widget top-level; a porta real do filho fica em port/direction e o caminho ate o filho fica em nestedPath.
Nao gere links nested via owner.widgetEvent, bindingPath profundo, page.connections ou wrappers host-specific. widgetEvent e bridge legada/avancada, nao contrato principal de authoring.
Payloads legados de layout ainda podem ser ingeridos, mas sao normalizados para canvas e nao devem ser reemitidos.
pageIdentity identifica o escopo de persistencia e nao pertence ao objeto page.
authoringCapabilities é um grant transitório do host para limitar affordances visíveis; não integra WidgetPageDefinition, não é persistido e não concede autoridade de edição à IA.
Este catálogo é específico para o runtime praxis-dynamic-page; operações de authoring/mutação pertencem ao manifesto do praxis-page-builder.
WidgetPageDefinition e o contrato canonico persistido: widgets, composition.links, state, context, i18n, layout, canvas, presets, grouping, slotAssignments, deviceLayouts e themePreset.
Widgets e page.composition.links sao arrays; ferramentas de patch legadas fazem merge por key estavel e id estavel.
page.canvas.items é um mapa por widget key; não modele canvas.items como array.
Taxonomia editorial: condition usa Json Logic canônico; transform usa pipeline declarativo; não trate ambos como a mesma "expression".
Para remocao/replace, use flags {_remove:true} ou {_replace:true} no item.
Para renomear um link, inclua {_beforeKey:"link-id-anterior"} no item.
Inputs de widgets dependem do componente (ex: praxis-table, praxis-dynamic-form). Evite inventar campos; prefira pedir confirmação.

Quando page.widgets[].definition.id for praxis-rich-content, o host praxis-dynamic-page injeta hostCapabilities em runtime para actions e capability gating; não serialize funções nem tente persistir page.widgets[].definition.inputs.hostCapabilities.
Use ids estaveis para links e keys estaveis para widgets.
Nested component ports usam endpoint component-port com nestedPath; o owner em ref.widget continua sendo o widget top-level.
Objetivo: compor widgets e relacionamentos canonicos (ex.: master-detail).
Link tipico de master-detail: component-port(table.rowClick) -> component-port(form.resourceId) com transform map payload.row.id.

options.label: Clique na linha (praxis-table)
options.example: Usar table.rowClick -> form.resourceId via transform pick-path payload.row.id

actionCatalog.safetyNotes: Use apenas resourcePath base. Evite inventar colunas; deixe config minima.
Use resourcePath base e mode=create|edit|view. Evite inventar campos.
Use transform pick-path payload.row.id para master-detail padrão.
Padrão master-detail: rowClick -> resourceId com transform pick-path payload.row.id.
Padrão master-detail: tabela (rowClick) -> formulario (resourceId) com transform pick-path payload.row.id.

hints: praxis-dynamic-page e runtime de composicao: consome WidgetPageDefinition, renderiza widgets e mantem relacoes em page.composition.links.
Mutações agentic de página pertencem ao manifesto do praxis-page-builder; use este context pack como descoberta/runtime guidance.
WidgetPageDefinition inclui widgets, composition.links, state, context, i18n, layout, canvas, layoutPreset, layoutPresetOptions, grouping, slotAssignments, deviceLayouts e themePreset.
page.i18n carrega copy de negócio do documento; use descritores PraxisTextValue explícitos em shells e inputs e preserve strings comuns como dados do domínio.
page.canvas.items é um mapa por widget key, não um array; cada entrada guarda col, row, colSpan, rowSpan, zIndex e constraints opcionais.
Widgets e composition.links sao arrays; o patching deve fazer merge por key (widgets) e por id (links).
Preferir mudanças incrementais: alterar/estender em vez de substituir toda a página.
Para remover um item, envie {_remove: true} junto ao widget/link.
Para substituir um item inteiro, envie {_replace: true}.
Para alterar origem/destino de link, use {_beforeKey} com o id antigo.
Use keys estaveis para widgets e ids estaveis para links ao criar composicoes.
resourcePath sempre e o path base do recurso (sem /filter, /all).
Praxis Table gera colunas dinamicamente a partir do resourcePath quando columns não forem definidas.
Praxis Dynamic Form gera campos dinamicamente a partir do resourcePath quando config não for definida.

Quando um widget praxis-rich-content estiver hospedado na página, definition.inputs.document continua sendo o contrato persistido; hostCapabilities é injetado somente em runtime pelo praxis-dynamic-page para actions e capability gating.
Praxis List pode filtrar via config.dataSource.query (enviado para /filter).
Quando houver recursos secundarios (ex.: enderecos), use contextHints.addressResourcePath.
Exemplo master-detail: tabela emite rowClick -> form.resourceId via transform pick-path payload.row.id.

Pattern Master-Detail: { "id":"master.rowClick->detail.resourceId", "from":{"kind":"component-port","ref":{"port":"rowClick","direction":"output"}}, "to":{"kind":"component-port","ref":{"port":"resourceId","direction":"input"}}, "transform":{"steps":[{"kind":"pick-path","config":{"path":"payload.row.id"}}]}}
Ao criar widgets, use inputs minimos e complemente depois (evite inventar campos).
Quando widgets ja existem, interpretar ports de origem/destino antes de conectar.
Intenção comum: criar página master-detail = criar tabela + criar formulário + conectar seleção via composition.links.
Intenção comum: ajustar página existente = modificar apenas widgets/inputs necessários.

Exemplo de link canonico (master-detail): { id:"masterTable.rowClick->detailForm.resourceId", from:{kind:"component-port",ref:{widget:"masterTable",port:"rowClick",direction:"output"}}, to:{kind:"component-port",ref:{widget:"detailForm",port:"resourceId",direction:"input"}}, intent:"event-propagation", transform:{version:"2.0",phase:"link-propagation",mode:"single-value",steps:[{kind:"pick-path",phase:"link-propagation",input:{source:"event"},config:{path:"payload.row.id"}}]}}
Exemplo de widget tabela (mínimo): { key:"masterTable", definition:{ id:"praxis-table", inputs:{ resourcePath:"/api/x" }}}
Exemplo de widget formulário (mínimo): { key:"detailForm", definition:{ id:"praxis-dynamic-form", inputs:{ resourcePath:"/api/x", mode:"view" }}}
Se houver idField conhecido, use transform pick-path payload.row.{idField} em links canonicos.

Capability Note:
  - page segue o modelo canonico WidgetPageDefinition (widgets, composition.links, context e state opcional); composition.links pode despachar actions globais via to.kind = global-action e receber continuations exatas via from.kind = global-action.

Capability Note:
  - Conteudo editorial rico deve ser modelado como widget praxis-rich-content com definition.inputs.document: RichContentDocument, nao como DSL local do page-builder.

Capability Note:
  - Quando definition.id = praxis-rich-content em uma pagina dinamica, definition.inputs.document continua sendo o contrato persistido; hostCapabilities e mediado em runtime pelo host praxis-dynamic-page e nao deve ser serializado no JSON da pagina.

Capability Note:
  - Edicao visual de inputs de widget deve usar ComponentDocMeta.configEditor ou ComponentDocMeta.authoringManifestRef publicado pela lib dona do componente; nao criar editor local no page-builder para semantica de outro pacote.

Capability Note:
  - Canvas e o modelo espacial canonico da pagina quando houver posicionamento explicito.

Capability Note:
  - Taxonomia editorial: condition usa Json Logic canonico; transform usa pipeline declarativo; policy cobre apenas comportamento operacional.

Capability Note:
  - Para criacao agentic de paginas, o preview pode trazer uiCompositionPlan como plano intermediario validavel; o page-builder compila esse plano para WidgetPageDefinition antes de aplicar.

Capability Note:
  - UiCompositionPlan usa widgets[].componentId e bindings declarativos. UiCompositionPlanTemplateReference pode piná-lo por registryKey + configSha256, mas precisa ser resolvido pelo backend governado antes da compilação. O JSON persistido continua sendo page.widgets[].definition.id e page.composition.links.

Capability Note:
  - Nested component ports usam endpoint component-port com nestedPath. O owner em ref.widget ou bindings[].*.widget continua sendo o widget top-level; a porta real do filho fica em port/direction e o caminho ate o filho fica em nestedPath.

Capability Note:
  - Nao gere links nested via owner.widgetEvent, bindingPath profundo, page.connections ou wrappers host-specific. widgetEvent e bridge legada/avancada, nao contrato principal de authoring.

Capability Note:
  - Payloads legados de layout ainda podem ser ingeridos, mas sao normalizados para canvas e nao devem ser reemitidos.

Capability Note:
  - pageIdentity identifica o escopo de persistencia e nao pertence ao objeto page.

Capability Note:
  - authoringCapabilities é um grant transitório do host para limitar affordances visíveis; não integra WidgetPageDefinition, não é persistido e não concede autoridade de edição à IA.

Capability Note:
  - Este catálogo é específico para o runtime praxis-dynamic-page; operações de authoring/mutação pertencem ao manifesto do praxis-page-builder.

Capability Note:
  - WidgetPageDefinition e o contrato canonico persistido: widgets, composition.links, state, context, i18n, layout, canvas, presets, grouping, slotAssignments, deviceLayouts e themePreset.

Capability Note:
  - Widgets e page.composition.links sao arrays; ferramentas de patch legadas fazem merge por key estavel e id estavel.

Capability Note:
  - page.canvas.items é um mapa por widget key; não modele canvas.items como array.

Capability Note:
  - Taxonomia editorial: condition usa Json Logic canônico; transform usa pipeline declarativo; não trate ambos como a mesma "expression".

Capability Note:
  - Para remocao/replace, use flags {_remove:true} ou {_replace:true} no item.

Capability Note:
  - Para renomear um link, inclua {_beforeKey:"link-id-anterior"} no item.

Capability Note:
  - Inputs de widgets dependem do componente (ex: praxis-table, praxis-dynamic-form). Evite inventar campos; prefira pedir confirmação.

Capability Note:
  - Quando page.widgets[].definition.id for praxis-rich-content, o host praxis-dynamic-page injeta hostCapabilities em runtime para actions e capability gating; não serialize funções nem tente persistir page.widgets[].definition.inputs.hostCapabilities.

Capability Note:
  - Use ids estaveis para links e keys estaveis para widgets.

Capability Note:
  - Nested component ports usam endpoint component-port com nestedPath; o owner em ref.widget continua sendo o widget top-level.

Capability Note:
  - Objetivo: compor widgets e relacionamentos canonicos (ex.: master-detail).

Capability Note:
  - Link tipico de master-detail: component-port(table.rowClick) -> component-port(form.resourceId) com transform map payload.row.id.

validators.description: Panel ids must be unique and stable within config.panels[].
Target panel must exist before applying the operation.
Panel ordering must use stable ids, not transient array index as identity.
Panel title must be a non-empty text value after localization/domain projection.
Panel description should remain plain header-support text and not replace panel content.
Panel icon metadata must remain compatible with PraxisIconDirective and editor round-trip.
Panel content must remain valid FieldMetadata[], WidgetDefinition[] or action button metadata.
Removing a panel with fields, widgets or action buttons is destructive and requires confirmation.
Default expanded state must reference an existing panel id.
Removing an expanded panel requires deterministic replacement state or explicit confirmation.
When accordion.multi is false, at most one panel may be marked expanded by default.
A disabled panel should not be the only expanded/default focus target without explicit intent.
Accordion behavior values must match ExpansionMetadata and Angular Material expansion bindings.
Panel content remains lazy through matExpansionPanelContent and should not require eager child runtime state.
Nested widget content remains governed by child component contracts and component-port nestedPath semantics.
Settings Panel editor, runtime persistence and registry projection must preserve panel ids, order, icons and expanded state.

roundTripRequirements: Operations must preserve stable panel ids; array index may be used only as a resolver fallback, never as canonical identity.
Settings Panel editor, runtime persistence and registry projection must round-trip ExpansionMetadata without losing panel ids, order, icons or expanded state.
When accordion.multi is false, authoring must collapse competing panels or fail validation instead of producing multiple default-expanded panels.
Lazy panel content remains represented by panels[].content, panels[].widgets and panels[].actionButtons; authoring cannot require eager child component instances.
Nested widgets remain delegated through WidgetDefinition and component-port nestedPath semantics instead of being redefined by the expansion contract.

handlerContract.description: Registers a package-owned control type in runtime and metadata registries using stable controlType and selector identities.
Adds a deterministic control alias that normalizes to one registered canonical controlType.
Removes one alias by normalized alias identity after validating replacement coverage for downstream configs.
Maps a selector to a deterministic controlType through FieldSelectorRegistry without using host-only selector conventions.
Validates editor/tooling discovery for one controlType separately from runtime rendering support.
Validates runtime registry and value-accessor coverage for one controlType without implying editor coverage.

validators.description: Package-owned control types must be unique and stable.
ComponentRegistryService must resolve the runtime component for the target controlType.
Control metadata must align with FieldMetadata semantics from @praxisui/core.
Aliases must normalize to a single canonical controlType.
Alias removal requires an existing alias target.
Alias removal must provide migration or replacement when downstream configs may still use it.
Destructive alias removal requires explicit confirmation.
Editorial descriptor updates require an existing package-owned descriptor.
Package-owned editorial changes must originate in src/lib/editorial/**, not host overrides.
Dynamic-form, metadata-editor and downstream tooling must discover the control metadata.
Metadata mappings must align with FIELD_METADATA_CAPABILITIES and control-family capabilities.
Runtime support and editor/tooling coverage must not diverge silently.
Coverage validation operations must include concrete evidence paths or spec names.
Selector mappings must resolve to one controlType through FieldSelectorRegistry and must not shadow package defaults implicitly.

roundTripRequirements: Runtime support, editorial descriptor, ComponentDocMeta and playground/catalog projection must remain aligned for package-owned fields.
Aliases must resolve through the canonical core normalization path and must not become host-only conventions.
Editor coverage and runtime coverage must be reported separately; runtime rendering alone is not sufficient evidence of editor/tooling support.

examples.request: Register a package-owned field control and make it runtime-resolvable.
Allow legacy alias my-control to resolve to myControl.
Remove obsolete alias old-control after migration.
Update friendly name and icon for a package-owned control.
Map pdx-my-control to myControl in the selector registry.
Publish a metadata capability path for option source mapping.
Prove that metadata editor and dynamic form can discover the control.
Prove runtime registry and value accessor coverage.
Mark a control supported because it renders, without editor metadata evidence.

controlProfiles.title: Text input controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for text-like controls, including inline and Material text inputs.

editableTargets.description: Text metadata paths such as placeholder, length limits, pattern, mask and autocomplete.

validators.description: Text constraints must preserve string field semantics and editor/runtime round-trip.

examples.request: Set placeholder and maximum length for a text input.

roundTripRequirements: Text constraints must round-trip through FieldMetadata and downstream tooling without becoming host-only placeholder state.

controlProfiles.title: Numeric controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for number, slider, range, rating and score controls.

editableTargets.description: Numeric metadata paths such as min, max, step, precision and display format.

validators.description: Numeric min, max, step and precision must be mutually valid for the target control.

examples.request: Set rating control to five points with half-step increments.

controlProfiles.title: Distance radius filter
controlProfiles.description: Profile for the inline radial distance filter, including units, semantic marks, presets, colors and governed draft confirmation.

editableTargets.description: Distance-radius metadata paths for value bounds, units, radial presentation, semantic marks, presets, adaptive sizing and overlay confirmation.

validators.description: Distance bounds, step, unit conversion, marks and presets must preserve ordered values in the canonical base unit.
Radial colors, opacity and adaptive overlay bounds must remain legible and theme-safe.

examples.request: Configure a kilometre distance range with semantic marks, presets and explicit Apply and Cancel actions.

roundTripRequirements: Distance values remain stored in distanceBaseUnit while the selected display unit remains metadata-driven.
Accent and semantic distance gradient stops round-trip independently through editor and runtime.
Explicit overlay mode keeps draft changes local until Apply and restores the baseline on Cancel.

controlProfiles.title: Currency controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for currency and price-range controls.

editableTargets.description: Currency metadata paths such as currency code, locale, precision and range mode.

validators.description: Currency controls require a valid ISO currency code and locale-aware formatting semantics.
Currency range bounds must be ordered and compatible with precision.

examples.request: Configure the currency field for Brazilian Real with two decimals.

controlProfiles.title: Select controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for select, autocomplete, async select, chips, status, sentiment and button-toggle controls.

editableTargets.description: Option source, local options, display/value fields, search and multi-select metadata paths.

validators.description: Option controls require canonical optionSource/options semantics, including cascade dependency mappings when present.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Configure select to store ids and display labels.

controlProfiles.title: Entity lookup controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for entity lookup controls that bind to remote resources.

editableTargets.description: Entity lookup metadata paths such as resourcePath, value/display fields and governed dialog search behavior.

validators.description: Entity lookup controls require canonical resource binding and stable value/display identity fields.
Option controls require canonical optionSource/options semantics, including cascade dependency mappings when present.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Bind the entity lookup to users, show the name while storing the id, use the inline trigger to change the selection, and provide governed advanced search.

controlProfiles.title: Tree select controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for hierarchical tree select controls.

editableTargets.description: Tree option metadata paths such as node id, parent id, children path, lazy loading and multi-selection.

validators.description: Tree controls require stable node identity and valid parent/children references.
Tree option sources must expose hierarchical data compatible with the configured node fields.

examples.request: Configure tree select with id, parentId and children fields.

controlProfiles.title: List and transfer controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for selection-list and transfer-list controls.

editableTargets.description: List option metadata paths such as options, selection mode, value field and ordering.

validators.description: List selection metadata must preserve stable option identity and selected value shape.
Value and display identity fields must exist in local options or the remote option source schema.

examples.request: Configure transfer list to store ids and display labels with a maximum of three selected items.

controlProfiles.title: Date controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for single date, datetime, month, week, year and time picker controls.

editableTargets.description: Date/time metadata paths such as min, max, timezone, locale and format.

operations.title: Configure date or time field metadata

validators.description: Temporal min and max values must be valid and ordered for the target control granularity.
Timezone configuration must use a valid named timezone when the control is timezone-sensitive.

examples.request: Limit the date field to the current year in Sao Paulo timezone.

controlProfiles.title: Date range controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for date range, month range, year range, period and relative-period controls.

editableTargets.description: Date range metadata paths such as start/end field mapping, min/max and presets.

validators.description: Date range controls require distinct start/end field semantics and ordered submitted values.
Temporal min and max values must be valid and ordered for the target control granularity.

examples.request: Use createdFrom and createdTo as the date range field names.

controlProfiles.title: Time range controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for time range controls.

editableTargets.description: Time range metadata paths such as start/end fields, step minutes and timezone.

validators.description: Time range controls require distinct start/end field semantics and valid interval steps.
Timezone configuration must use a valid named timezone when the control is timezone-sensitive.

examples.request: Configure a time range with fifteen minute increments.

controlProfiles.title: Toggle controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for boolean toggle controls.

editableTargets.description: Boolean metadata paths such as true label, false label and default value.

validators.description: Toggle controls must preserve boolean value semantics and not serialize labels as submitted values.

examples.request: Set yes/no labels for a toggle without changing boolean submission.

controlProfiles.title: Color controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for color input, precision picker and inline semantic color controls.

editableTargets.description: Color metadata paths such as format, structured fallback palettes and a versioned governed palette reference.

validators.description: Color values and local palette entries must be valid CSS color expressions.
A governed palette reference requires a published palette key and must honor a pinned version or ETag when supplied.

examples.request: Use the published corporate status palette version 3 for state colors.

controlProfiles.title: Regional document controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for Brazilian CPF/CNPJ document input controls.

editableTargets.description: Canonical Brazilian document metadata paths for full inputs and explicitly semantic partial-search filters.

validators.description: Regional document controls must preserve canonical document type, version, display mask and optional full-document validation semantics.

examples.request: Accept CPF or CNPJ and validate the complete document.

controlProfiles.title: File upload controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for file upload controls that bind field metadata to accepted file types, limits and storage semantics.

editableTargets.description: File upload metadata paths such as accepted types, maximum file size, multiplicity and upload endpoint binding.

validators.description: File upload controls require explicit file type, size and multiplicity constraints before storage binding.
Upload endpoint metadata must map to the canonical host/backend upload contract instead of an ad hoc URL.

examples.request: Allow up to three PDF files with a five megabyte limit.

controlProfiles.title: Collection controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for repeatable collection controls that manage array-shaped field values.

editableTargets.description: Collection metadata paths such as item schema, minimum and maximum items, ordering and add/remove behavior.

validators.description: Collection controls require array-compatible item schema and stable item identity semantics.

examples.request: Configure a repeatable address collection with at least one item.

controlProfiles.title: Avatar controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for avatar controls that render image, initials, fallback identity metadata or governed avatar groups.

editableTargets.description: Avatar metadata paths such as image source, initials, fallback icon, size, tone, status, badge, group stack and accessible text.

validators.description: Avatar controls must keep display metadata separate from submitted domain value semantics.

examples.request: Use Ada initials with verified presence, a compact corporate badge and selected reviewer emphasis.

controlProfiles.title: Display and action controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for non-data or action-like field controls.

editableTargets.description: Display/action metadata paths such as label, icon, action id, loading state and presentation mode.

validators.description: Display/action controls must not silently mutate submitted domain data unless an explicit action contract exists.

examples.request: Configure a button field to trigger the refresh action.

controlProfiles.title: Field shell controls
controlProfiles.description: Profile for wrapper/shell controls that host another field contract.

editableTargets.description: Shell metadata paths such as label, hint, error projection, layout and child control reference.

validators.description: Field shell controls must delegate child semantics to the child control profile instead of redefining them.

examples.request: Set shell label and delegate rendering to inline select.

validators.description: Accepted type edits must provide a non-empty explicit list and may not rely on wildcard-only policy.
Each accepted type must be a valid extension, exact MIME type or controlled subtype wildcard.
ui.accept hints must remain consistent with options.allowedExtensions and options.acceptMimeTypes when backend validation is configured.
Single file size limits must be positive numeric byte and MB values.
Single file size limits must not exceed the platform upload policy for the selected backend surface.
limits.maxFileSizeBytes and options.maxUploadSizeMb must describe the same effective maximum when both are present.
Bulk file count limits must be positive integers.
Bulk size limits must be positive numeric byte values when provided.
Bulk count and aggregate size limits must not exceed backend batch policy.
Endpoint edits must use a safe absolute or approved relative baseUrl and reject javascript:, data:, credentials-in-URL and path traversal.
Endpoint edits must resolve to the approved Praxis files backend surface for the host environment.
Presign authoring may change baseUrl but must preserve POST baseUrl/upload/presign?filename=... as the runtime contract.
Direct upload authoring may change baseUrl but must preserve POST baseUrl/upload as the runtime contract.
Bulk upload authoring may change baseUrl but must preserve POST baseUrl/bulk as the runtime contract.
Cross-origin presigned upload targets must not receive Praxis metadata/options fields unless explicitly approved by the presign response contract.
Endpoint and security policy edits require explicit confirmation before patch compilation.
Strict validation, virus scanning, conflict policy, target directory, quota and rate-limit settings must be compatible with backend effective config.
Target directory values must be normalized backend paths and must reject traversal or absolute filesystem paths.
Default conflict policy must be one of ERROR, SKIP, OVERWRITE, MAKE_UNIQUE or RENAME.
Quota and rate-limit UX settings must use non-negative retry counts/backoffs and cannot silently bypass backend enforcement.
Contextual header names must be explicit HTTP token names and must not override authorization, cookie or content-type headers.
Error message overrides should target known backend error catalog codes or documented host-specific extensions.
User-facing error messages must remain compatible with the host i18n/editor flow and not expose raw technical exception text.
Error message overrides must be non-empty user-facing text.
Display mode must be full or compact.
Display changes must keep progress, manual upload and metadata form affordances reachable for the selected mode.
Settings Panel editor, AI adapter snapshot and runtime inputs must round-trip config, baseUrl and displayMode without changing upload behavior.

roundTripRequirements: Accepted type authoring must keep UI hints and backend-facing validation options aligned; ui.accept alone is not the canonical server policy.
Endpoint authoring changes only the canonical files API baseUrl and strategy; direct, bulk and presign paths remain fixed by FilesApiClient.
Security-affecting edits require confirmation and must round-trip through Settings Panel persistence without weakening strict validation, virus scanning, quota or rate-limit policy by omission.
Error message overrides remain keyed by backend error catalog code and must stay user-facing/i18n-compatible.
Display authoring may change displayMode and UI flags, but must not mutate backend options or upload submission payload.

praxis-filter.description: Filtro metadata-driven hospedável em páginas dinâmicas, adequado para superfícies analíticas, operacionais e workflows orientados a busca.

inputs.name: presentation
inputs.description: Apresentação governada da região de filtros e do comando avançado; projeção de FilterConfig.presentation.

inputs.name: resourcePath
inputs.description: Endpoint base usado para resolver o schema de filtros e os metadados remotos.

inputs.name: apiUrlEntry
inputs.description: Origem explícita da API para hosts destacados que renderizam o filtro fora do injector de rota.

inputs.name: fieldMetadata
inputs.description: Metadata estático opcional para uso offline, showcases ou hosts sem schema remoto.

inputs.name: filterId
inputs.description: Identificador opcional do filtro para persistência e observabilidade.

inputs.name: formId
inputs.description: Identificador do formulário avançado usado pelo runtime do filtro.

inputs.name: componentInstanceId
inputs.description: Identificador estável quando há múltiplas instâncias do filtro na mesma página.

inputs.name: enableCustomization
inputs.description: Habilita affordances de customização e governança de schema no runtime do filtro.

inputs.name: showFilterSettings
inputs.description: Exibe o botão de configurações do filtro para hosts que desejam authoring visual embutido.

inputs.name: showAdvancedButton
inputs.description: Controla se a barra mostra o botão de filtros avançados.

inputs.name: showAddButton
inputs.description: Controla se a barra mostra o seletor para adicionar campos de filtro ao runtime.

inputs.name: showClearButton
inputs.description: Controla se a barra mostra a ação para limpar o DTO de filtros atual.

inputs.name: showSearchButton
inputs.description: Controla se a barra mostra uma ação explícita de busca além das emissões de change/submit.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: DTO atual do filtro aplicado pelo host.

inputs.name: alwaysVisibleFields
inputs.description: Campos priorizados na barra inline do filtro para cenários de busca recorrente.

inputs.name: alwaysVisibleFieldMetadataOverrides
inputs.description: Overrides de metadata para refinar UX inline por página sem redefinir o contrato canônico.

inputs.name: selectedFieldIds
inputs.description: Lista adicional de campos expostos ao usuário além dos always-visible.

inputs.name: persistenceKey
inputs.description: Chave de persistência do estado do filtro quando o host desejar continuidade entre sessões.

inputs.name: disablePersistence
inputs.description: Desliga a persistência local do filtro em hosts efêmeros ou publicados.

inputs.name: changeDebounceMs
inputs.description: Janela de debounce para emissões de change/submit.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.description: Atalhos de filtros fornecidos pelo host.

inputs.name: allowSaveTags
inputs.description: Permite salvar novos atalhos diretamente no runtime do filtro.

inputs.name: i18n
inputs.description: Overrides de copy do filtro para encaixe editorial em diferentes tipos de página.

inputs.name: placeBooleansInActions
inputs.description: Move toggles simples para a área de ações quando a densidade da página exigir barra mais enxuta.

inputs.name: advancedOpenMode
inputs.description: Modo de abertura do formulário avançado.

outputs.name: submit
outputs.description: DTO submetido pelo usuário.

outputs.name: requestSearch
outputs.description: Evento canônico de busca emitido pelo filtro para hosts metadata-driven.

outputs.name: change
outputs.description: DTO parcial emitido durante alterações locais.

outputs.name: contextChange
outputs.description: Projeção de apresentação com o DTO canônico e os rótulos resolvidos para composição de página; não deve ser enviada ao backend.

outputs.name: clear
outputs.description: Emitido quando o usuário limpa o filtro atual.

outputs.name: tagsChange
outputs.description: Emitido quando atalhos salvos/predefinidos são alterados.

outputs.name: selectedFieldIdsChange
outputs.description: Emitido quando o usuário confirma em Aplicar uma nova curadoria de campos visíveis; alterações provisórias e canceladas não emitem o evento.

outputs.name: metaChanged
outputs.type: { schemaId: string; serverHash?: string; context: SchemaIdParams }
outputs.description: Propaga metadados do schema efetivamente usado pelo filtro.

outputs.name: schemaStatusChange
outputs.type: { outdated: boolean; serverHash?: string; lastVerifiedAt?: string; formId?: string }
outputs.description: Sinaliza drift de schema para hosts que precisam reagir operacionalmente.

actions.label: Pesquisar
actions.description: Solicita a execução da busca com o DTO atual do filtro.

actions.label: Limpar
actions.description: Solicita a limpeza do estado atual do filtro.

ports.label: Filter Value
ports.description: Controlled filter DTO applied by the host.

ports.label: Filter Change
ports.description: Filter DTO emitted after a local value change.

ports.label: Request Search
ports.description: Canonical search request carrying the current filter DTO.

ports.label: Filter View Context
ports.description: Presentation projection with the canonical filter DTO and display labels resolved from field metadata and option sources.

ports.label: Clear Filter
ports.description: Event emitted after the current filter DTO is cleared.

operations.title: Configure standalone filter settings
operations.description: Merges a partial, runtime-backed FilterConfig patch while preserving host-owned inputs and excluding the controlled value DTO.

validators.description: Every alwaysVisibleFields and selectedFieldIds entry must exist in the governed filter request metadata or schema.
Apply, save, reset and reopen must preserve unrelated host inputs while projecting only FilterConfig-backed settings.

roundTripRequirements: Apply and save must preserve resource, metadata, identity and unknown host inputs.
The controlled value input must never be copied into the persisted authoring result.
Reset must restore the settings captured when the editor opened without changing the saved widget definition.
Reopen must materialize the last saved FilterConfig-backed inputs without TableConfig paths.
advancedOpenMode must persist only the canonical values 'modal' or 'drawer'.

examples.request: Show a Filtros heading and label the advanced filter action Mais filtros.
Use the visual filter heading to change the query value.
Keep employeeName and employeeStatus visible and add department to this standalone filter.
Open this standalone filter in a drawer and use compact date controls.
Persist the current filter value as authoring configuration.
Persist a host metadata override for employeeStatus.
Enable the table query builder on this standalone filter.

hints: Use fieldMetadata[].name as the canonical field id; avoid array indexes.
Local fields are real form controls. Create them in fieldMetadata[] with source:"local", usually transient:true and submitPolicy:"omit", then place them as kind:"field" layout items.
submitPolicy accepts only "omit", "include", or "includeWhenDirty". If legacy prompt text says "never", normalize it to "omit" before persisting.
Visual blocks are not fields. Store them only as kind:"richContent" layout items and never in fieldMetadata[].
Use sections[].rows[].columns[].items[] as the canonical mixed layout order. kind:"field" items reference fieldMetadata; kind:"richContent" items are visual blocks outside submit payload.
Keep sections[].rows[].columns[].fields[] only as a field projection/migration path; do not create visual blocks there.
For visualBlock formRules that change text, title, or message in a composed richContent document, use textNodeId, titleNodeId, or messageNodeId from the rule authoring context.

For field formRules that must calculate a FormControl value, use effect.properties.value with the closed envelope { expression: <JSON Logic> }, such as { expression: { yearsSince: [{ var: "birthDate" }] } }. Use the closed envelope { literal: <value> } for structured literal objects; do not add extra keys and do not generate TypeScript functions.

For conditional side effects, use formCommandRules with effects[].kind:"global-action" and a structured globalAction ref. The visual editor authors the primary effect and preserves secondary effects from advanced JSON. Do not put alert/modal/navigation commands inside formRules[].effect.properties.
LLM-created formRules must include metadata.origin:"llm" and metadata.reviewStatus:"pending"; never write generated formRulesState.
Domain guidance rules should usually target visualBlock when they only change advisory copy, compliance warnings, or operational instructions without changing submitted data.
For layout edits, prefer adding or merging sections/rows/columns instead of replacing arrays. Use _delete: true for removal.
Avoid non-serializable hooks or functions in patches; use plain strings or ask for manual edits.
When adding sections/rows/columns, provide a unique "id" for each new element.
For nested layout changes (column within a row within a section), explicitly define "target.sectionId", "target.rowId", "target.columnId" in user prompt for clarity.
DOC: Widget purpose: dynamic form driven by FormConfig (layout + fields).
DOC: Host inputs: config (optional, defaults to { sections: [] }) and resourcePath (optional). mode is optional (create/edit/view).
DOC: When config is provided, sections[] define layout; fieldMetadata[] defines fields referenced by sections.
DOC: If the form should be schema-driven, resourcePath + schemaSource are needed to fetch schema.
DOC: resourcePath must be the base resource path only (no /filter, /all, /{id}). CRUD endpoints are handled internally.

validators.description: List id must remain stable for persistence and editor reopen flows.
Bound template and selection fields must exist in local data or schema context when available.
Template expressions must use supported ${item.path} syntax and allowed pipes.
Item actions must declare stable unique ids.
Target action id must exist before update or removal.
Destructive action removal requires explicit confirmation.
Remote resource binding must use canonical resource metadata and safe resourcePath values.
When binding resourcePath, tools must account for dataSource.data taking precedence over remote data.
Selection mode and return policy must match the runtime enum.
Layout density and related enum values must match PraxisListConfig.
Action visibility conditions must be serializable Json Logic.
Structured globalAction refs must use a registered action id when registry context is available.
The list config editor and JSON editor must preserve the saved shape without drift.
Template slot names must be one of the runtime-supported catalog slots.
Skin values must match the runtime-supported skin contract.
Inline styles and classes must be safe for the host sanitization policy.
Template display options must match the runtime enum contract.
Skeleton counts must be numeric and non-negative.
Local list data must be an array and must not hide an intended remote binding accidentally.
Sort entries must use the canonical field,direction format or labeled sort option shape.
Remote list query must be a serializable object compatible with the resource filter contract.
Locale and currency values should be valid BCP 47 / ISO currency values when host validation is available.
Accessibility labels must be non-empty when provided.
Export formats and scopes must match the shared collection export contract.
Declarative event names must be stable host event identifiers.
Fields documented as declared-only may round-trip through config/editor without changing current runtime behavior.
Row layout columns must use supported slots and enum values.
Action and expansion placements must be reachable from the active row layout.
Interaction expansion values must match the runtime enum contract.
List style and slot override rules must declare stable unique ids.
Expansion sections must declare stable unique ids.
Expansion section, data source, schema contract and rendering values must match the runtime contract.

roundTripRequirements: List editor must preserve templating.primary, templating.secondary, templating.leading, templating.trailing and templating.emptyState.
Actions must round-trip by actions[].id rather than array index.
Rules must round-trip by rules.itemStyles[].id and rules.slotOverrides[].id rather than array index.
Expansion sections must round-trip by expansion.sections[].id rather than array index.
Row layout must preserve executive slots identity, balance, limit, risk, alerts, owner, actions and expand.
Export configuration must preserve the shared collection export scope and format contract.
dataSource.data precedence over dataSource.resourcePath must remain explicit when binding remote resources.

hints: Use fieldMetadata[].name as the canonical field id; avoid array indexes.
Local fields are real form controls. Create them in fieldMetadata[] with source:"local", usually transient:true and submitPolicy:"omit", then place them as kind:"field" layout items.
submitPolicy accepts only "omit", "include", or "includeWhenDirty". If legacy prompt text says "never", normalize it to "omit" before persisting.
Visual blocks are not fields. Store them only as kind:"richContent" layout items and never in fieldMetadata[].
Use sections[].rows[].columns[].items[] as the canonical mixed layout order. kind:"field" items reference fieldMetadata; kind:"richContent" items are visual blocks outside submit payload.
Keep sections[].rows[].columns[].fields[] only as a field projection/migration path; do not create visual blocks there.
For visualBlock formRules that change text, title, or message in a composed richContent document, use textNodeId, titleNodeId, or messageNodeId from the rule authoring context.

For field formRules that must calculate a FormControl value, use effect.properties.value with the closed envelope { expression: <JSON Logic> }, such as { expression: { yearsSince: [{ var: "birthDate" }] } }. Use the closed envelope { literal: <value> } for structured literal objects; do not add extra keys and do not generate TypeScript functions.

For conditional side effects, use formCommandRules with effects[].kind:"global-action" and a structured globalAction ref. The visual editor authors the primary effect and preserves secondary effects from advanced JSON. Do not put alert/modal/navigation commands inside formRules[].effect.properties.
LLM-created formRules must include metadata.origin:"llm" and metadata.reviewStatus:"pending"; never write generated formRulesState.
Domain guidance rules should usually target visualBlock when they only change advisory copy, compliance warnings, or operational instructions without changing submitted data.
For layout edits, prefer adding or merging sections/rows/columns instead of replacing arrays. Use _delete: true for removal.
Avoid non-serializable hooks or functions in patches; use plain strings or ask for manual edits.
When adding sections/rows/columns, provide a unique "id" for each new element.
For nested layout changes (column within a row within a section), explicitly define "target.sectionId", "target.rowId", "target.columnId" in user prompt for clarity.
DOC: Widget purpose: dynamic form driven by FormConfig (layout + fields).
DOC: Host inputs: config (optional, defaults to { sections: [] }) and resourcePath (optional). mode is optional (create/edit/view).
DOC: When config is provided, sections[] define layout; fieldMetadata[] defines fields referenced by sections.
DOC: If the form should be schema-driven, resourcePath + schemaSource are needed to fetch schema.
DOC: resourcePath must be the base resource path only (no /filter, /all, /{id}). CRUD endpoints are handled internally.

Removes a manual field by stable field name and requires explicit confirmation before metadata, layout or value loss.
Sets a manual field label through the metadata bridge without redefining backend schema semantics.

Configures the manual customization toolbar and keeps metadata edit entry points behind enableCustomization.

validators.description: Manual field names must be unique in the instance metadata map.
Target manual field must exist before patching or removing it.
Removing a field or its persisted value requires explicit confirmation.
Manual field label must be a non-empty user-facing string.
Manual field metadata must correspond to a host template control or declared metadata bridge target.
Control type must be discovered through dynamic-fields mappings or delegated discovery.
Metadata bridge patches must not silently redefine backend schema or schema-driven FormConfig semantics.
Advanced FieldMetadata edits must be delegated to the metadata-editor manifest.
Advanced FormConfig semantics must be delegated to the dynamic-form manifest.
Layout field references must resolve to manual fields.
Manual layout metadata must not pretend to rewrite host-owned HTML template structure.
Toolbar quick edit flags must be supported by the manual field toolbar.
Metadata bridge entry points must respect enableCustomization.
Autosave enablement and persistence policy must be explicit.
Autosave debounce must be positive and safe for storage backends.
Autosave requires a valid AsyncConfigStorage implementation.
Persistence key composition must be deterministic across reopen/reload.
Submit behavior must map to supported manual form outputs or delegated dynamic-form semantics.
Open, edit, apply/save, reopen and runtime consume must preserve manual form config.

roundTripRequirements: ManualFormInstance is the package-level runtime document: config, field metadata map, FormGroup and persistence key must remain coherent.
Manual field ids are stable field names; array indexes are not canonical identity.
Field removal is destructive and requires confirmation before metadata, layout references or persisted values are removed.
Autosave must be explicit, have a safe debounce and use deterministic persistence key composition through ManualFormPersistenceOptions.
The metadata bridge may apply metadata-editor patches but must not silently redefine backend schema or duplicate FieldMetadata semantics.
Advanced FormConfig authoring belongs to praxis-dynamic-form; this manifest governs manual form orchestration and delegates deeper FormConfig semantics.

editableTargets.description: Canonical FieldMetadata root and property paths.
Control type selected from dynamic-fields discovery and editor config registry.
Canonical option source including backend x-ui option source fields where applicable.
Cascade dependencies and dependency filter mappings edited through CascadeManagerTab.
Dynamic editor renderer property coverage and editor component mapping.
Field validation rules and contextual validators.
Governed static date range shortcut catalog for dateRange and inlineDateRange metadata.
Authoring hints, help text and contextual guidance for metadata editors.
Schema normalization and seed hydration rules.

handlerContract.description: Sets a canonical FieldMetadata property through a governed metadata path and re-runs schema normalization.
Changes control type only when dynamic-fields discovery and metadata-editor config registry both expose renderer/editor coverage.
Configures canonical optionSource fields while preserving backend x-ui dependsOn and dependencyFilterMap semantics.
Applies cascade dependencies through CascadeRulesService using the metadata-editor save contract while preserving backend x-ui optionSource dependency semantics during hydration.
Configures visual renderer coverage for a metadata property and rejects JSON-only support for required visual authoring.
Adds a canonical validation rule and verifies contextual validator availability before persistence.
Sets structured FieldMetadata hint/help/accessibility text through canonical metadata paths and metadata-editor i18n constraints.
Configures built-in and backend-resolved static date range shortcuts through the canonical shortcuts array; JSON metadata may not contain calculateRange or executable expressions.
Runs metadata-editor schema normalization while preserving canonical advanced FieldMetadata properties and editor/runtime round-trip.

validators.description: Edited metadata must remain compatible with canonical FieldMetadata.
Edited paths must be supported by visual editor coverage or explicitly delegated.
Control type must exist in dynamic-fields discovery.
Control type and property must have metadata-editor coverage.
Option source must use canonical FieldMetadata/x-ui shape.
Remote option sources must resolve through governed resource or endpoint metadata.
Cascade source and dependent fields must exist.
Cascade dependencies must not create cycles.
Cascade config must preserve x-ui optionSource dependsOn and dependencyFilterMap semantics.
Renderer editor type must be registered.
JSON-only support is not accepted for required visual authoring coverage.
Validation rule must use canonical metadata shape.
Contextual validator must be registered before use.
Context hints must remain structured metadata, not free-form host-only strings.
Authoring hint text must remain compatible with metadata-editor i18n.
Date range shortcuts must be built-in ids or static backend-resolved ranges with id, label, startDate and endDate.
Metadata shortcuts must not contain calculateRange, executable expressions, local calendar-law rules, or frontend business-day logic.
Static business shortcuts must use unique ids inside the date range field.
Normalization must not drop canonical advanced FieldMetadata properties.
Runtime and editor must consume the same normalized metadata shape.
Open, edit, apply/save, reopen and runtime consume must preserve metadata.

roundTripRequirements: FieldMetadata is the canonical edited document shape; backend x-ui-derived metadata must not be rewritten into host-only aliases.
Control type changes require both dynamic-fields discovery and metadata-editor visual coverage.
Option source cascades preserve x-ui optionSource.dependsOn and optionSource.dependencyFilterMap semantics.
Date range business shortcuts are authored as built-in ids or backend-resolved static ranges; browser metadata never carries calculateRange code or business calendar rules.
JSON-only support is incomplete when visual editor coverage is required.
Schema normalization must preserve advanced canonical properties through open, edit, apply/save, reopen and runtime consumption.

componentCapabilityNotes: page segue o modelo canonico WidgetPageDefinition (widgets, composition.links, context e state opcional); composition.links pode despachar actions globais via to.kind = global-action e receber continuations exatas via from.kind = global-action.
Conteudo editorial rico deve ser modelado como widget praxis-rich-content com definition.inputs.document: RichContentDocument, nao como DSL local do page-builder.

Quando definition.id = praxis-rich-content em uma pagina dinamica, definition.inputs.document continua sendo o contrato persistido; hostCapabilities e mediado em runtime pelo host praxis-dynamic-page e nao deve ser serializado no JSON da pagina.

Edicao visual de inputs de widget deve usar ComponentDocMeta.configEditor ou ComponentDocMeta.authoringManifestRef publicado pela lib dona do componente; nao criar editor local no page-builder para semantica de outro pacote.
Canvas e o modelo espacial canonico da pagina quando houver posicionamento explicito.
Taxonomia editorial: condition usa Json Logic canonico; transform usa pipeline declarativo; policy cobre apenas comportamento operacional.
Para criacao agentic de paginas, o preview pode trazer uiCompositionPlan como plano intermediario validavel; o page-builder compila esse plano para WidgetPageDefinition antes de aplicar.

UiCompositionPlan usa widgets[].componentId e bindings declarativos. UiCompositionPlanTemplateReference pode piná-lo por registryKey + configSha256, mas precisa ser resolvido pelo backend governado antes da compilação. O JSON persistido continua sendo page.widgets[].definition.id e page.composition.links.

Nested component ports usam endpoint component-port com nestedPath. O owner em ref.widget ou bindings[].*.widget continua sendo o widget top-level; a porta real do filho fica em port/direction e o caminho ate o filho fica em nestedPath.
Nao gere links nested via owner.widgetEvent, bindingPath profundo, page.connections ou wrappers host-specific. widgetEvent e bridge legada/avancada, nao contrato principal de authoring.
Payloads legados de layout ainda podem ser ingeridos, mas sao normalizados para canvas e nao devem ser reemitidos.
pageIdentity identifica o escopo de persistencia e nao pertence ao objeto page.
authoringCapabilities é um grant transitório do host para limitar affordances visíveis; não integra WidgetPageDefinition, não é persistido e não concede autoridade de edição à IA.

hints: For agentic page creation, prefer returning uiCompositionPlan in the preview envelope and let the page-builder compiler emit WidgetPageDefinition.

Carry page-owned i18n, explicit context, canonical layout and governed widget shell in uiCompositionPlan; when a PraxisTextValue key exists in the fallbackLocale dictionary, omit repeated text and let the compiler materialize the executable fallback.
Use uiCompositionPlan.widgets[].componentId in plans; the compiler maps it to page.widgets[].definition.id.

Use uiCompositionPlan.selectionSyncs for repeated selection projections, contextScopes for repeated explicit widget context, and bindings for remaining wiring; constant values and state.initial become explicit inputs, while state references compile to page.composition.links.

Para invalidacao de selecao, use fallbackValue no mesmo transform pick-path. Para materializar conteudo ou empty/reset em um unico binding, use select-case com branches when/value e defaultValue total; nao crie pares condition + :clear.
For nested component ports, use component-port endpoints with nestedPath in uiCompositionPlan.bindings; keep widget as the top-level owner and put the real child port in port/direction.
NestedPath must be relative to the owner widget and must end with a widget segment containing a stable key. Do not use index as the only identity.
Do not author nested links through owner.widgetEvent, deep bindingPath, page.connections, or host-specific wrapper outputs; those are legacy or bridge mechanisms.
Do not emit uiCompositionPlan shorthands/bindings and hand-authored page.composition.links as competing sources of truth for the same preview.
Use page.widgets[].key as the merge key; avoid array indexes.
Canvas items use 1-based col/row with integer spans.
Widget definition id must match a registered component selector.

Use runtimeState.componentCatalog for available component ids, input/output descriptors, semantic ports, insertion presets, actions, commands, configEditor availability, and authoringManifestRef delegation.
Use page.composition.links as the canonical persisted wiring surface.
Composition links should use stable ids and canonical component-port/state endpoints.
For global-action targets, keep execution declarative: use to.kind = global-action with to.ref.actionId plus optional to.ref.payload, payloadExpr and meta only.
For uiCompositionPlan transforms, use pick-path for event payload extraction, query-context for resource filters, template for structured document/input generation, and constant for fixed values.
Write semantic guards to page.composition.links[].condition as Json Logic, not as legacy filter strings.
Write operational behavior to page.composition.links[].policy, not mixed into condition or metadata.
Transforms and metadata must be written under the link envelope, not as legacy connection fields.
To remove a widget, use _delete: true with the widget key.
To remove a link, use _delete: true with the same canonical from/to endpoints.

validators.description: The document must remain a renderable WidgetPageDefinition.
Legacy GridPageDefinition semantics cannot be reintroduced.
Page context must stay JSON-serializable.
Settings panel apply/save/reset/reopen must preserve the same page shape.
Canvas columns must be an integer grid count.
Canvas row unit must be a positive layout unit.
Canvas gap must be a valid non-negative spacing value.
Every canvas item must reference an existing widgetKey.
Widget keys must be unique.
Widget component id must exist in the component registry/catalog.
Canvas item geometry must be valid.
Child component input edits must delegate to the child owner.
Array index is not a stable widget identity.
Target widget must exist.
Destructive removals require explicit confirmation.
Removing a widget must remove dangling composition links.
Moved canvas item must target an existing widget.
Canvas overlap policy must be respected.
Widget shell config must match the shell editor contract.
Settings panel bridge must be available for shell/page editors.
Shell edits cannot mutate child inputs.
Composition link ids must be unique.
Composition endpoints must resolve to known widgets, ports and nested paths.
Nested component-port paths must terminate at a stable widget key.
Composition link condition must be valid Json Logic.
Operations must write page.composition.links, not legacy connections.
Target composition link must exist.
Remaining composition links must still validate after the operation.
UiCompositionPlan must match the intermediate agentic plan contract.
Compiled output must be a valid WidgetPageDefinition.
Compiled plan must produce unique widget keys.
State paths must be valid page state paths.
State layer must be page or session.
State values must be JSON-serializable.
State edits must not break composition links.
Agentic preview result must be structurally valid.
UiCompositionPlan apply requires the ComponentMetadataRegistry of the target host.
Every planned component must resolve materializable metadata in the target registry.
Preview envelope must include compiledFormPatch.patch.page.
Runtime persistence cannot save the full preview envelope.
Runtime page must remain renderable by praxis-dynamic-page.
Save requires component type, component id and scope identity.
Save must respect backend ETag/If-Match policy.
Delegated child component must expose an authoring manifest or configEditor.
Delegated child operation id must be known.
ComponentDocMeta.configEditor must remain the source for child input editing.
Page-builder must not define child component input semantics locally.

roundTripRequirements: WidgetPageDefinition is the canonical persisted runtime page shape for page-builder.
UiCompositionPlan is an intermediate agentic plan and must compile before local preview/apply.

Page side inset is authored through UiCompositionPlan.layout.paddingInline and materialized as page.layout.paddingInline. It accepts a CSS length or var(); 0px removes it and omission inherits the host --pdx-page-padding-inline token. Device-specific overrides live under deviceLayouts.*.layout.paddingInline. The inset belongs to the page, not to widget shell body padding or table cells.

UiCompositionPlan.i18n, context and layout compile into the corresponding WidgetPageDefinition fields so a complete page never depends on host-only enrichment. A key-only PraxisTextValue receives text from the fallbackLocale dictionary when available.
UiCompositionPlan.selectionSyncs is an authoring shorthand that compiles into explicit canonical page.composition.links and is never persisted in WidgetPageDefinition.
UiCompositionPlan.contextScopes compiles constants and state.initial into explicit widget inputs, and state context into explicit page.composition.links; runtime inheritance is never ambient.
UiCompositionPlan transforms devem ser totais: use fallbackValue para invalidacao de selecao e select-case com defaultValue para materializar conteudo ou empty/reset sem bindings clear paralelos.
UiCompositionPlan global-action sources declare only actionId; dynamicPage.composition.dispatch supplies the runtime payload, and target-only payload fields fail closed on sources.
Widget keys and composition link ids are stable identities; array indexes are never canonical identities.
Persisted wiring uses page.composition.links and must not write legacy connections.

The connection editor supports format-value in WidgetPageDefinition links with explicit config.format. This does not extend the UiCompositionPlanTransform shorthand. Invalid date/mask values prevent delivery and retain the previous target; plan identity, empty state and failures together.
Nested component ports use component-port refs with nestedPath ending in a stable widget key.
Child widget definition.inputs edits delegate to the child manifest or ComponentDocMeta.configEditor.

Agentic preview preflights UiCompositionPlan against the target registry and applies the attested WidgetPageDefinition; persistence rebuilds patch.page from that page while the surrounding envelope remains diagnostics/audit data.
Save uses pageIdentity and ETag policy from praxis-config-starter; pageIdentity is not persisted inside WidgetPageDefinition.
Settings panel apply/save/reset/reopen must preserve page settings and widget shell config without hidden normalization drift.

examples.request: Set this page title to Payroll Overview and store payrollPeriod in the page context.
Use a 12 column dashboard grid with compact gaps.
Add an employees table widget to the left half of the first row.
Remove the summary-card widget and its links.
Move payroll-chart to the right column and make it taller.
Rename the employees widget card and enable the refresh shell action.
When department-list selection changes, filter employees-table by department id.
Remove the old payroll-filter-link composition link.
Compile the resource-dashboard plan returned by the assistant into a renderable page preview.
Store selectedDepartmentId in page state for downstream links.
Apply the current assistant preview to the local page.
Save this page configuration using the current ETag.
Add a salary column to the employees table widget.
Directly write a new dynamic-form field into the widget inputs from page-builder.
Create the widget link under the old connections collection.

  - Quando definition.id = praxis-rich-content em uma pagina dinamica, definition.inputs.document continua sendo o contrato persistido; hostCapabilities e mediado em runtime pelo host praxis-dynamic-page e nao deve ser serializado no JSON da pagina.

Capability Note:
  - Edicao visual de inputs de widget deve usar ComponentDocMeta.configEditor ou ComponentDocMeta.authoringManifestRef publicado pela lib dona do componente; nao criar editor local no page-builder para semantica de outro pacote.

Capability Note:
  - Canvas e o modelo espacial canonico da pagina quando houver posicionamento explicito.

Capability Note:
  - Taxonomia editorial: condition usa Json Logic canonico; transform usa pipeline declarativo; policy cobre apenas comportamento operacional.

Capability Note:
  - Para criacao agentic de paginas, o preview pode trazer uiCompositionPlan como plano intermediario validavel; o page-builder compila esse plano para WidgetPageDefinition antes de aplicar.

Capability Note:
  - UiCompositionPlan usa widgets[].componentId e bindings declarativos. UiCompositionPlanTemplateReference pode piná-lo por registryKey + configSha256, mas precisa ser resolvido pelo backend governado antes da compilação. O JSON persistido continua sendo page.widgets[].definition.id e page.composition.links.

Capability Note:
  - Nested component ports usam endpoint component-port com nestedPath. O owner em ref.widget ou bindings[].*.widget continua sendo o widget top-level; a porta real do filho fica em port/direction e o caminho ate o filho fica em nestedPath.

Capability Note:
  - Nao gere links nested via owner.widgetEvent, bindingPath profundo, page.connections ou wrappers host-specific. widgetEvent e bridge legada/avancada, nao contrato principal de authoring.

Capability Note:
  - Payloads legados de layout ainda podem ser ingeridos, mas sao normalizados para canvas e nao devem ser reemitidos.

Capability Note:
  - pageIdentity identifica o escopo de persistencia e nao pertence ao objeto page.

Capability Note:
  - authoringCapabilities é um grant transitório do host para limitar affordances visíveis; não integra WidgetPageDefinition, não é persistido e não concede autoridade de edição à IA.

inputs.description: Registro pai usado para resolver parentIdPathVariable.

inputs.description: ResourcePath do recurso pai para contexto da surface.

inputs.description: Apresentação usada no payload de abertura host-mediated.

inputs.description: QueryContext base mesclado com o filtro canônico da relação filha.

inputs.name: tableId
inputs.description: Identidade estável da tabela filha para persistência, observabilidade e testes.

inputs.name: tableConfig
inputs.description: Configuração parcial mesclada ao preset canônico. inputs.name: emptyState

inputs.name: enableCustomization
inputs.description: Opt-in explicito para authoring governado da tabela filha.

inputs.name: authoringCapability
inputs.description: Capability publica do EnterpriseRuntimeContext exigida quando o authoring da tabela filha estiver habilitado.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Renderiza a tabela filha inline ou emite payload para abertura host-mediated.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: Override de estado para hosts/outlets que estejam carregando discovery remoto.

inputs.name: stateReason
inputs.description: Motivo governado associado ao override de estado.

inputs.name: compact
inputs.description: Reduz densidade visual dos estados não materializados.

inputs.name: strictValidation
inputs.description: Validação estrita do widget materializado pelo DynamicWidgetLoader.

inputs.name: ownerWidgetKey
inputs.description: Identidade do owner usada para correlacionar eventos do widget filho.

outputs.name: surfaceOpen
outputs.description: Emitido em modo open-action com o payload pronto de surface.open.

outputs.name: widgetEvent
outputs.description: Reemite eventos do widget filho materializado.

outputs.name: resourceEvent
outputs.description: Promove eventos canonicos emitidos pelo widget filho materializado.

editableTargets.description: The canonical RichContentDocument input envelope.
A top-level document.nodes[] block with stable id preferred over index.
Text-bearing nodes, including text, badge, metric, progress, card and timeline labels.
Canonical link node with label, href, target and rel.
Image, avatar image and mediaBlock child nodes.
Timeline nodes with visual placement, connector, marker and semantic appearance settings.
Timeline items nested inside timeline nodes; stable item id is preferred over index.
Common node metadata such as testId, className, visibleWhen and safe style.
Preset nodes resolved through PRAXIS_RICH_BLOCK_PRESETS or hostCapabilities.resolvePreset.
Document validation policy enforced by validateRichContentDocument.
Layout and rootClassName runtime inputs.

handlerContract.description: Creates a supported RichBlockNode, validates it with validateRichContentDocument semantics and inserts it by stable neighbor id when provided.
Removes a link node by stable id or path and optionally replaces it with a text node containing the prior link label.
Resolves a rich-block preset through the governed registry/host mediation and inserts or replaces a preset reference without serializing functions.
Updates the structured mediaBlock avatar/title/subtitle fields while preserving meta and trailing content for advanced JSON authoring.
Updates timeline node display and semantic appearance settings while preserving timeline items and the canonical RichTimelineNode shape.
Adds a timeline item to a timeline node using stable timeline and item ids when present; array index is a resolver fallback only.
Updates a timeline item by stable item id when available, preserving the item object shape accepted by RichTimelineItem.
Removes a timeline item from a timeline node after explicit confirmation; stable item id is preferred over index.
Validates requested policy against the fixed validator guardrails; rich-content authoring remains structured JSON and does not allow arbitrary HTML.

validators.description: Documents must satisfy RichContentDocument with kind praxis.rich-content, version 1.0.0 and a nodes array.
Only document version 1.0.0 is supported.
Nodes must use supported rich-content node types, including link as a structured node rather than arbitrary HTML.
Stable block ids should be unique when present; operations should prefer ids over array indexes.
Target block must exist before patching, reordering or removing it.
Block ordering must use stable ids or explicit before/after placement and not rely on transient generated indexes.
Block and link removal are destructive and require confirmation.
Removal should not leave an empty document unless the user explicitly requested an empty rich content document.
Text updates may only target fields supported by the selected node type.
Expression paths must remain simple context paths or Json Logic expressions, not string DSL code.
Link href values must reject javascript:, vbscript:, file: and unsafe data URLs.
Links must declare safe target/rel behavior; _blank links default to noopener noreferrer.
Link removal must resolve an existing link node by stable id or path.
Image, avatar and link URL fields must reject unsafe protocols and null bytes.
Inline style values must reject script, import, binding and data URL expressions.
Rich-content authoring must remain structured document JSON and must not accept arbitrary HTML/script patches.
Security policy requests must keep HTML disabled and URL/style guardrails explicit.
Sanitization policy changes require explicit confirmation.
Preset refs must use kind rich-block plus namespace, presetId and optional version.
Preset application must resolve through PRAXIS_RICH_BLOCK_PRESETS or a host-mediated resolver.
Public contracts must not serialize host capability functions; only refs and inputs are persisted.
Layout must be block or inline.
rootClassName must contain safe CSS class tokens; unsafe values block authoring and are ignored by the runtime.
Config editor, Settings Panel payload and runtime renderer must preserve document structure, layout and rootClassName.
Node className values must contain safe CSS class tokens.
visibleWhen must be a Json Logic expression object and not a string DSL.
Media operations must target a mediaBlock node and preserve structured avatar/text child nodes.
Timeline item operations must target a timeline node with an items array.
Timeline items must be objects matching RichTimelineItem fields.
Timeline item ids should be unique inside a timeline node when present.
Timeline item updates and removals must resolve an existing item by stable id or explicit fallback index.
Timeline item updates may only target supported RichTimelineItem fields.
Timeline display settings must use supported position, connector, marker, emphasis, density and text appearance enum values.

roundTripRequirements: The editor must produce the same widget input envelope consumed by page-builder: inputs.document, inputs.layout and inputs.rootClassName.
Rich content must remain structured RichContentDocument JSON; arbitrary HTML and script URL patches are rejected before persistence.
Block identity should prefer document.nodes[].id; array index is a resolver fallback only and cannot be the canonical identity for generated patches.
Link authoring uses canonical link nodes with safe href/target/rel instead of markdown or raw HTML embedded in text nodes.
MediaBlock, timeline node appearance, timeline item, metadata, visibleWhen and safe style authoring use the same structured paths exposed by the visual config editor.
Preset authoring persists only rich-block refs and inputs; host capability functions remain runtime-mediated and are not serialized.
